footnotes.zh: 但以理书论到神截定给以色列的定命，就是七十个七的内容(九24～27)。本书也论到从宁录到敌基督的人类政权。因着以色列和人类的政权是为着基督，所以本书也启示基督的某些方面，祂是神行动的圆心与圆周，中心与普及。但以理书特别启示基督的死(九25～26)、祂再来时的显现(二34～35，45)、祂的得着权柄与国度(七13～14)、祂是神那些受苦见证人的同伴(三23～25)以及祂的超越(十4～9)。 但以理书的中心思想是：诸天的掌权(四26)，就是天上之神的掌权(二37，44)，管理地上整个人类政权，以配合神永远的经纶，使基督得以了结旧造，使新造有新生的起头，并得以打碎、压毁人类政权的集大成，建立神永远的国。

footnotes.en: 1:1 1 In The book of Daniel concerns the destiny of Israel apportioned out by God, the contents of the seventy weeks (Dan. 9:24-27). It also concerns human government from Nimrod to Antichrist. Because Israel and human government are for Christ, this book also reveals certain aspects of Christ, who is the center and the circumference, the centrality and the universality, of God's move. In particular, it reveals Christ's death (Dan. 9:25-26), His appearing in His second coming (Dan. 2:34-35, 45), His receiving dominion and a kingdom (Dan. 7:13-14), His being the companion of the suffering witnesses of God (Dan. 3:23-25), and His excellency (Dan. 10:4-9). The central thought of Daniel is that the ruling of the heavens (Dan. 4:26), i.e., of the God of the heavens (Dan. 2:37, 44), over all human government on earth matches God's eternal economy so that Christ would terminate the old creation for the germination of the new creation and would smash and crush the aggregate of human government and establish the eternal kingdom of God.

footnotes.en: 1:2 1 Shinar The origin of Babylon was Babel in the land of Shinar, which is Chaldea (Gen. 11:2, 9, 28; Dan. 1:1-2, 4). For the children of Israel to be taken captive to Babylon means that they were captured back to the place of the worship of idols (Jer. 50:1, 38), i.e., back to Babel, to the original place where their forefather Abraham had worshipped idols (Josh. 24:2-3). Abraham was called by God out of Chaldea to Canaan to worship God (Acts 7:2-4). By this, the worship of the unique God, which had been lost through Adam's fall, was resumed (Gen. 12:5-8). Eventually, because of their degradation God's people were taken back to the very place out of which Abraham had been called. See note Jer. 50:1 1 , par. 1, and note Jer. 50:15 1 .

footnotes.zh: 巴比伦的起源乃是在示拿地(就是迦勒底)的巴别(创十一2，9，28，但一1～2，4)。以色列人被掳到巴比伦，意思就是他们被掳回到拜偶像之处(耶五十1，38)，也就是回到巴别，到他们先祖亚伯拉罕原初拜偶像之处(书二四2～3)。亚伯拉罕蒙神呼召，从迦勒底出来，到迦南敬拜神(徒七2～4)。借此，因亚当堕落所失去那对独一之神的敬拜，就得以恢复(创十二5～8)。但至终神的百姓因着堕落，竟被带回到亚伯拉罕从前蒙召所脱离之处。见耶五十1注1一段，15注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 巴比倫的起源乃是在示拿地（就是迦勒底）的巴別。（創十一2，9，28，但一1～2，4。）以色列人被擄到巴比倫，意思就是他們被擄回到拜偶像之處，（耶五十1，38，）也就是回到巴別，到他們先祖亞伯拉罕原初拜偶像之處。（書二四2～3。）亞伯拉罕蒙神呼召，從迦勒底出來，到迦南敬拜神。（徒七2～4。）藉此，因亞當墮落所失去那對獨一之神的敬拜，就得以恢復。（創十二5～8。）但至終神的百姓因著墮落，竟被帶回到亞伯拉罕從前蒙召所脫離之處。見耶五十1註1一段，15註1。

footnotes.zh: 尼布甲尼撒那属鬼魔的试诱，首先引诱神失败的选民中四个卓越的年轻后裔，就是但以理和他的三个同伴，要使他们有分于王不洁的食物，就是献给偶像的食物，而受玷污。王自己所用的膳是玷污人的、不洁的，因为曾献给尼布甲尼撒的诸神。但以理和他的同伴若吃那些食物，就是接受玷污，接受偶像，因而与撒但成为一(参林前十19～21)。原则上，这乃是试诱人吃善恶知识树，使人联于撒但(参创三1～6)。当但以理和他的同伴拒绝吃尼布甲尼撒不洁的食物，而拣选吃蔬菜时(8～16)，原则上，他们就是拒绝善恶知识树，而接受生命树，使他们与神成为一(参创二9，16～17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 尼布甲尼撒那屬鬼魔的試誘，首先引誘神失敗的選民中四個卓越的年輕後裔，就是但以理和他的三個同伴，要使他們有分於王不潔的食物，就是獻給偶像的食物，而受玷污。王自己所用的膳是玷污人的、不潔的，因為曾獻給尼布甲尼撒的諸神。但以理和他的同伴若喫那些食物，就是接受玷污，接受偶像，因而與撒但成為一。（參林前十19～21。）原則上，這乃是試誘人喫善惡知識樹，使人聯於撒但。（參創三1～6。）當但以理和他的同伴拒絕喫尼布甲尼撒不潔的食物，而揀選喫蔬菜時，（8～16，）原則上，他們就是拒絕善惡知識樹，而接受生命樹，使他們與神成為一。（參創二9，16～17。）
footnotes.en: 1:5 1 choice Nebuchadnezzar's devilish temptation was first to seduce the four brilliant young descendants of God's defeated elect, Daniel and his three companions, to be defiled by partaking of his unclean food, food offered to idols. The king's choice provision was defiling, unclean, for it had been offered to Nebuchadnezzar's gods. For Daniel and his companions to eat that food would have been to take in the defilement, to take in the idols, and thus to become one with Satan (cf. 1 Cor. 10:19-21). In principle, this was a temptation to eat the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, which joins man to Satan (cf. Gen. 3:1-6). When Daniel and his companions refused to eat Nebuchadnezzar's unclean food and chose instead to eat vegetables (vv. 8-16), in principle they rejected the tree of the knowledge of good and evil and took the tree of life, which caused them to be one with God (cf. Gen. 2:9, 16-17).

refs.text_gb: 王与他们谈论，见少年人中，无一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅；于是他们就在王面前侍立。
refs.text_big5: 王與他們談論，見少年人中，無一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅；於是他們就在王面前侍立。
refs.text_en: And the king spoke with them. And among them all none were found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; therefore they stood in the presence of the king.

refs.text_gb: 大卫到了扫罗那里，就侍立在扫罗面前。扫罗甚喜爱他，他就作了扫罗拿兵器的人。
refs.text_big5: 大衛到了掃羅那裏，就侍立在掃羅面前。掃羅甚喜愛他，他就作了掃羅拿兵器的人。
refs.text_en: And David came to Saul and entered his service. And Saul loved him greatly, and he became his armor bearer.

refs.text_gb: 扫罗差遣人去见耶西，说，求你让大卫侍立在我面前，因为他在我眼前蒙了恩。
refs.text_big5: 掃羅差遣人去見耶西，說，求你讓大衛侍立在我面前，因為他在我眼前蒙了恩。
refs.text_en: And Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, Let David enter my service, for he has found favor in my sight.

refs.text_gb: 属你的人是有福的！你的这些臣仆，常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话，是有福的！
refs.text_big5: 屬你的人是有福的！你的這些臣僕，常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話，是有福的！
refs.text_en: Happy are your men! Happy are these your servants, who attend you continually and hear your wisdom!

footnotes.zh: 尼布甲尼撒在他对但以理及其同伴所施那属鬼魔的试诱中，也将原来指明他们是属于神的名字，改为使他们与偶像成为一的名字(6～7)。但以理这名，意思是‘神是我的审判者’，被改为伯提沙撒，意思是‘彼勒(赛四六1)的王子’，或‘彼勒所宠爱的。’哈拿尼雅这名，意思是‘耶和华曾以恩慈赐与’，或‘蒙耶和华恩宠’，被改为沙得拉，意思是‘蒙日神光照。’米沙利这名，意思是‘谁是神所是的’，被改为米煞，意思是‘谁能像女神煞克。’亚撒利雅这名，意思是‘耶和华曾帮助’，被改为亚伯尼歌，意思是‘火神尼歌的忠仆。’
footnotes.zh_big5: 尼布甲尼撒在他對但以理及其同伴所施那屬鬼魔的試誘中，也將原來指明他們是屬於神的名字，改為使他們與偶像成為一的名字。（6～7。）但以理這名，意思是“神是我的審判者，”被改為伯提沙撒，意思是“彼勒（賽四六1）的王子，”或“彼勒所寵愛的。”哈拿尼雅這名，意思是“耶和華曾以恩慈賜與，”或“蒙耶和華恩寵，”被改為沙得拉，意思是“蒙日神光照。”米沙利這名，意思是“誰是神所是的，”被改為米煞，意思是“誰能像女神煞克。”亞撒利雅這名，意思是“耶和華曾幫助，”被改為亞伯尼歌，意思是“火神尼歌的忠僕。”
footnotes.en: 1:6 1 Daniel In his devilish tempting of Daniel and his companions, Nebuchadnezzar also changed their names, which indicated that they belonged to God, to names that made them one with idols (vv. 6-7). The name Daniel, meaning God is my Judge, was changed to Belteshazzar, meaning the prince of Bel, or the favorite of Bel (Isa. 46:1); the name Hananiah, meaning Jah has graciously given, or favored of Jah, was changed to Shadrach, meaning enlightened by the sun god; the name Mishael, meaning Who is what God is? was changed to Meshach, meaning Who can be like the goddess Shach? and the name Azariah, meaning Jah has helped, was changed to Abed-nego, meaning the faithful servant of the fire god Nego.

refs.text_gb: 其中虽有挪亚、但以理、约伯这三人，他们只能因他们的义救自己的性命，这是主耶和华说的。
refs.text_big5: 其中雖有挪亞、但以理、約伯這三人，他們只能因他們的義救自己的性命，這是主耶和華說的。
refs.text_en: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in the midst of it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness, declares the Lord Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 你比但以理更有智慧，什么秘密的事都不能向你隐藏；
refs.text_big5: 你比但以理更有智慧，甚麼祕密的事都不能向你隱藏；
refs.text_en: Indeed you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret hidden from you;

refs.text_gb: 末后那照我神的名称为伯提沙撒，里头有圣神明之灵的但以理，来到我面前；我将梦告诉他，说，
refs.text_big5: 末後那照我神的名稱為伯提沙撒，裏頭有聖神明之靈的但以理，來到我面前；我將夢告訴他，說，
refs.text_en: But at last there came in before me Daniel, whose name is Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is a spirit of the holy gods; and I told the dream to him, saying,

refs.text_gb: 因为在他里头有美好的灵，又有知识聪明，能圆梦，释谜语，解难题，这人名叫但以理，尼布甲尼撒王称他为伯提沙撒；现在可以把但以理召来，他必讲解说明。
refs.text_big5: 因為在他裏頭有美好的靈，又有知識聰明，能圓夢，釋謎語，解難題，這人名叫但以理，尼布甲尼撒王稱他為伯提沙撒；現在可以把但以理召來，他必講解說明。
refs.text_en: Because an excellent spirit and knowledge and insight, and the interpretation of dreams, the declaring of riddles, and the resolving of problems were found in this Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Let Daniel now be called, and he will declare the interpretation.

refs.text_gb: 但以理求王，王就派沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌管理巴比伦省的事务；只是但以理常在王的朝廷中。

refs.text_en: And Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego over the administration of the province of Babylon; but Daniel was at the king's court.

verses.text_gb: 但以理却[Fn1]立定心意，不以王的膳和王所饮的酒[Cra]玷污自己，所以求太监长容他不玷污自己。

verses.text_en: But Daniel set his heart not to defile himself with the king's choice provision and with the wine that the king drank, so he requested of the leader of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但以理却立定心意，不以王的膳和王所饮的酒玷污自己，所以求太监长容他不玷污自己。

footnotes.zh: 但以理争战反抗，放胆拒绝鬼魔的试诱(8～13)。神尊重但以理的争战(14～20)，但以理和他的同伴成了神失败选民之遗民中的得胜者。因着神的选民被掳到巴比伦，表面上，神在地上的权益遭受挫败；实际上，神却借着年轻的得胜者，保守了对祂的敬拜和祂的见证。选民虽失败，年轻的得胜者却得胜了。他们的得胜就是神的得胜。因着这个得胜，神可以向撒但夸口说，在巴比伦境内，神仍有一些得胜者，胜过撒但的计谋。至终，借着神被掳选民中的得胜者，如但以理和他的同伴，神得以转移时代，将祂被掳子民中的遗民，带回迦南地(见王上十九18注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 但以理爭戰反抗，放膽拒絕鬼魔的試誘。（8～13。）神尊重但以理的爭戰，（14～20，）但以理和他的同伴成了神失敗選民之遺民中的得勝者。因著神的選民被擄到巴比倫，表面上，神在地上的權益遭受挫敗；實際上，神卻藉著年輕的得勝者，保守了對祂的敬拜和祂的見證。選民雖失敗，年輕的得勝者卻得勝了。他們的得勝就是神的得勝。因著這個得勝，神可以向撒但誇口說，在巴比倫境內，神仍有一些得勝者，勝過撒但的計謀。至終，藉著神被擄選民中的得勝者，如但以理和他的同伴，神得以轉移時代，將祂被擄子民中的遺民，帶回迦南地。（見王上十九18註1。）
footnotes.en: 1:8 1 set Daniel fought the battle by countering the devil's temptation with bold rejection (vv. 8-13). God honored Daniel's fighting (vv. 14-20), and Daniel and his companions became the overcomers among the remnant of God's defeated elect. Because of the captivity of God's elect in Babylon, apparently God was defeated in His interests on earth. Actually, He preserved His worship and testimony through the young overcomers. The elect were defeated, but the young overcomers were victorious. Their victory was God's victory. Because of this victory God could boast to Satan that in the midst of Babylon, God still had some overcomers who were victorious over Satan's devices. Eventually, it was through the overcomers among God's captured elect, such as Daniel and his companions, that God was able to turn the age and bring a remnant of His captured people back to the land of Canaan (see note 1 Kings 19:18 1 ).

refs.text_en: But that we write to them to abstain from the contaminations of idols and fornication and what is strangled and blood.

refs.text_gb: 我说，哎，主耶和华啊！我素来未曾被玷污；从幼年到如今，我没有吃过自死的，或被野兽撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。
refs.text_big5: 我說，哎，主耶和華阿！我素來未曾被玷污；從幼年到如今，我沒有喫過自死的，或被野獸撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。
refs.text_en: Then I said, Ah, Lord Jehovah. Indeed my soul has never been defiled; for from my youth until now I have not eaten anything that has died of itself or has been torn to pieces, nor has any abominable flesh entered into my mouth.

refs.text_gb: 彼得却说，主啊，绝对不可，因为一切凡俗并不洁之物，我从来没有吃过。
refs.text_big5: 彼得卻說，主阿，絕對不可，因為一切凡俗並不潔之物，我從來沒有喫過。
refs.text_en: But Peter said, By no means, Lord, for I have never eaten anything common and unclean.

refs.text_gb: 祂又在王和谋士面前，并王一切大能的军长面前施慈爱与我。因耶和华我神的手帮助我，我就得以坚强，从以色列中招聚首领，与我一同上来。

refs.text_en: And has extended lovingkindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the mighty officers of the king. And I was strengthened according to the hand of Jehovah my God upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel leading men to go up with me.

verses.text_gb: 太监长对但以理说，我惧怕我主我王，他已经派定你们的饮食；为何叫他看见你们的面貌，比你们同岁的少年人瘦弱难看呢？这样，你们就使我的头在王那里难保。

verses.text_en: And the leader of the eunuchs said to Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and drink; for why should he see your faces being more morose than those of the children who are of your own age? Then you would bring guilt upon my head before the king.

refs.text_big5: 利百加的哥哥和她母親說，讓少女同我們再住幾天，至少十天，然後她可以去。
refs.text_en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the girl stay with us a few days, ten or so; after that she may go.

refs.text_gb: 过了十天，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
refs.text_big5: 過了十天，耶和華的話臨到耶利米。
refs.text_en: And at the end of ten days the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah.

refs.text_gb: 你将要受的苦你不用怕。看哪，魔鬼将要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们受试炼；你们必受患难十日。你务要至死忠信，我就赐给你那生命的冠冕。
refs.text_big5: 你將要受的苦你不用怕。看哪，魔鬼將要把你們中間幾個人下在監裏，叫你們受試煉；你們必受患難十日。你務要至死忠信，我就賜給你那生命的冠冕。
refs.text_en: Do not fear the things that you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison that you may be tried, and you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

verses.text_gb: 然后当面察看我们的面貌，和用王膳那些少年人的面貌；就照你所看的待仆人吧。
verses.text_big5: 然後當面察看我們的面貌，和用王膳那些少年人的面貌；就照你所看的待僕人罷。
verses.text_en: Then let our countenances be watched in your presence, as well as the countenances of the children who eat the king's choice provision; and do with your servants according to what you see.
verses.text_gb_plain: 然后当面察看我们的面貌，和用王膳那些少年人的面貌；就照你所看的待仆人吧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 然後當面察看我們的面貌，和用王膳那些少年人的面貌；就照你所看的待僕人罷。

verses.text_big5: 委辦便允准他們這件事，試看他們十天。
verses.text_en: So he listened to them in this matter and tested them for ten days.

verses.text_big5: 於是委辦撤去派定他們用的膳、飲的酒，只給他們蔬菜喫。
verses.text_en: Therefore the steward withheld their portion of the choice provision and the wine that they were to drink and gave them vegetables.

verses.text_big5_plain: 於是委辦撤去派定他們用的膳、飲的酒，只給他們蔬菜喫。

verses.text_gb: 这四个少年人，神在各样学问、[Cra]智慧上，赐给他们知识聪明；但以理又明白各样的[Crb]异象和梦兆。
verses.text_big5: 這四個少年人，神在各樣學問、[Cra]智慧上，賜給他們知識聰明；但以理又明白各樣的[Crb]異象和夢兆。
verses.text_en: Now as for these four children, God gave them knowledge and insight in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这四个少年人，神在各样学问、智慧上，赐给他们知识聪明；但以理又明白各样的异象和梦兆。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這四個少年人，神在各樣學問、智慧上，賜給他們知識聰明；但以理又明白各樣的異象和夢兆。

refs.text_gb: 我就照你的话而行。看哪，我赐你智慧和明辨的心，甚至在你以前没有像你的，在你以后也没有兴起来像你的。
refs.text_big5: 我就照你的話而行。看哪，我賜你智慧和明辨的心，甚至在你以前沒有像你的，在你以後也沒有興起來像你的。
refs.text_en: I now do according to your words. I now give you a heart of wisdom and understanding, so that there has been no one like you before you, nor will one rise up after you like you.

refs.text_gb: 摩西在埃及人的一切智慧上受了训练，说话行事都有能力。
refs.text_big5: 摩西在埃及人的一切智慧上受了訓練，說話行事都有能力。
refs.text_en: And Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was powerful in his words and works.

refs.text_gb: 法老对约瑟说，我作了一个梦，没有人能解；我听见人说，你听了梦就能解。
refs.text_big5: 法老對約瑟說，我作了一個夢，沒有人能解；我聽見人說，你聽了夢就能解。
refs.text_en: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have had a dream, but there is no one who can interpret it; and I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.

refs.text_gb: 约瑟回答法老说，这不在于我，神必将平安的话回答法老。
refs.text_big5: 約瑟回答法老說，這不在於我，神必將平安的話回答法老。
refs.text_en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not of me; God will give Pharaoh a favorable answer.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华就说，你们且听我的话：你们中间若有申言者，我耶和华必在异象中使他认识我，我要在梦中与他说话。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華就說，你們且聽我的話：你們中間若有申言者，我耶和華必在異象中使他認識我，我要在夢中與他說話。
refs.text_en: He said, Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, / I, Jehovah, will make Myself known to him in a vision; / I will speak with him in a dream.

refs.text_gb: 通晓神异象的撒迦利亚在世的日子，乌西雅定意寻求神；他寻求耶和华，神就使他亨通。
refs.text_big5: 通曉神異象的撒迦利亞在世的日子，烏西雅定意尋求神；他尋求耶和華，神就使他亨通。
refs.text_en: And he set himself to seek after God during the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought after Jehovah, God caused him to prosper.

refs.text_gb: 在你国中有一个人，他里头有圣神明的灵，你先祖在世的日子，见这人里头有光，又有聪明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他为术士、用法术的、迦勒底人、并观兆者的领袖；
refs.text_big5: 在你國中有一個人，他裏頭有聖神明的靈，你先祖在世的日子，見這人裏頭有光，又有聰明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他為術士、用法術的、迦勒底人、並觀兆者的領袖；
refs.text_en: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is a spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your forefather light and insight and wisdom like the wisdom of the gods were found in him. And King Nebuchadnezzar your forefather-your forefather, O king-made him chief of the magicians, conjurers, Chaldeans, and diviners,

refs.text_gb: 因为在他里头有美好的灵，又有知识聪明，能圆梦，释谜语，解难题，这人名叫但以理，尼布甲尼撒王称他为伯提沙撒；现在可以把但以理召来，他必讲解说明。
refs.text_big5: 因為在他裏頭有美好的靈，又有知識聰明，能圓夢，釋謎語，解難題，這人名叫但以理，尼布甲尼撒王稱他為伯提沙撒；現在可以把但以理召來，他必講解說明。
refs.text_en: Because an excellent spirit and knowledge and insight, and the interpretation of dreams, the declaring of riddles, and the resolving of problems were found in this Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Let Daniel now be called, and he will declare the interpretation.

refs.text_gb: 我听说你里头有神明的灵，并且有光，又有聪明和超越的智慧。
refs.text_big5: 我聽說你裏頭有神明的靈，並且有光，又有聰明和超越的智慧。
refs.text_en: Now I have heard about you that a spirit of the gods is in you and that light and insight and surpassing wisdom are found in you.

refs.text_gb: 波斯王古列第三年，有话启示给称为伯提沙撒的但以理；这话是真的，是指极大的困苦，但以理明白这话，懂得这异象。
refs.text_big5: 波斯王古列第三年，有話啟示給稱為伯提沙撒的但以理；這話是真的，是指極大的困苦，但以理明白這話，懂得這異象。
refs.text_en: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia a word was revealed to Daniel, who was named Belteshazzar; and the word was true and concerning a great distress. And he understood the word and had an understanding of the vision.

verses.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒王吩咐带进少年人来的日期到了，太监长就把他们带到王面前。
verses.text_big5: 尼布甲尼撒王吩咐帶進少年人來的日期到了，太監長就把他們帶到王面前。

verses.text_gb_plain: 尼布甲尼撒王吩咐带进少年人来的日期到了，太监长就把他们带到王面前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 尼布甲尼撒王吩咐帶進少年人來的日期到了，太監長就把他們帶到王面前。

verses.text_big5: 王與他們談論，見少年人中，無一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅；於是他們就在王面前侍立。
verses.text_en: And the king spoke with them. And among them all none were found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; therefore they stood in the presence of the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王与他们谈论，见少年人中，无一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅；于是他们就在王面前侍立。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王與他們談論，見少年人中，無一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅；於是他們就在王面前侍立。

verses.text_gb: 王考问他们一切智慧、学问的事，见他们比通国的术士和用法术的，胜过十倍。
verses.text_big5: 王考問他們一切智慧、學問的事，見他們比通國的術士和用法術的，勝過十倍。
verses.text_en: And in every matter of wisdom and understanding that the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and conjurers who were in all his realm.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王考问他们一切智慧、学问的事，见他们比通国的术士和用法术的，胜过十倍。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王考問他們一切智慧、學問的事，見他們比通國的術士和用法術的，勝過十倍。

verses.text_gb: 直到[Cra]古列王[Fn1]元年，但以理还在。
verses.text_big5: 直到[Cra]古列王[Fn1]元年，但以理還在。
verses.text_en: And Daniel continued until the first year of Cyrus the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 直到古列王元年，但以理还在。

refs.text_gb: 然而巴比伦王古列元年，古列王降旨建造神的这殿。
refs.text_big5: 然而巴比倫王古列元年，古列王降旨建造神的這殿。
refs.text_en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon, King Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.

refs.text_gb: 论古列说，他是我的牧人，必成就我所喜悦的一切，就是论到耶路撒冷说，她必被建造，论到圣殿说，她的根基必立稳。
refs.text_big5: 論古列說，他是我的牧人，必成就我所喜悅的一切，就是論到耶路撒冷說，她必被建造，論到聖殿說，她的根基必立穩。
refs.text_en: Who says to Cyrus, He is My shepherd, / And he will fulfill all My desire, / Even by saying of Jerusalem, She will be built, / And of the temple, Her foundations will be laid.

verses.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他作了梦，灵里[Cra]烦乱，[Crb]不能睡觉。
verses.text_big5: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他作了夢，靈裏[Cra]煩亂，[Crb]不能睡覺。
verses.text_en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams and his spirit was troubled and his sleep left him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他作了梦，灵里烦乱，不能睡觉。
verses.text_big5_plain: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他作了夢，靈裏煩亂，不能睡覺。

refs.text_gb: 到了早晨，法老灵里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和智慧人来；法老把所作的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老讲解。
refs.text_big5: 到了早晨，法老靈裏不安，就差人召了埃及所有的術士和智慧人來；法老把所作的夢告訴他們，卻沒有人能給法老講解。
refs.text_en: And in the morning his spirit was troubled, so he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men; and Pharaoh told them his dream, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

refs.text_gb: 我作了一个梦使我惧怕，我在床上的思念并脑中的异象使我惊惶；
refs.text_big5: 我作了一個夢使我懼怕，我在床上的思念並腦中的異象使我驚惶；
refs.text_en: I saw a dream and it frightened me, and the imaginings upon my bed and the visions of my head alarmed me.

refs.text_gb: 那夜王睡不着觉，就吩咐人取年代记事录来；人就在王面前念给他听。
refs.text_big5: 那夜王睡不著覺，就吩咐人取年代記事錄來；人就在王面前念給他聽。
refs.text_en: On that night the king could not sleep, so he gave orders to bring the book of the records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

refs.text_gb: 王回宫，终夜不食，无人拿乐器到他面前；并且睡不着觉。
refs.text_big5: 王回宮，終夜不食，無人拿樂器到他面前；並且睡不著覺。
refs.text_en: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting; and no entertainment was brought before him, and his sleep fled from him.

verses.text_big5_plain: 王吩咐人將術士、用法術的、行邪術的、和迦勒底人召來，要他們將王的夢告訴王；他們就來站在王前。

refs.text_gb: 到了早晨，法老灵里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和智慧人来；法老把所作的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老讲解。
refs.text_big5: 到了早晨，法老靈裏不安，就差人召了埃及所有的術士和智慧人來；法老把所作的夢告訴他們，卻沒有人能給法老講解。
refs.text_en: And in the morning his spirit was troubled, so he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men; and Pharaoh told them his dream, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

refs.text_gb: 于是法老也召了智慧人和行邪术的来；他们是埃及行法术的，也用秘咒照样而行。
refs.text_big5: 於是法老也召了智慧人和行邪術的來；他們是埃及行法術的，也用祕咒照樣而行。
refs.text_en: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. And they also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same with their secret spells.

refs.text_gb: 所以我降旨召巴比伦的一切哲士到我面前，叫他们把梦的讲解告诉我。
refs.text_big5: 所以我降旨召巴比倫的一切哲士到我面前，叫他們把夢的講解告訴我。
refs.text_en: Therefore I made the decree to bring before me all the wise men of Babylon that they might make the interpretation of the dream known to me.

refs.text_gb: 于是那些术士、用法术的、迦勒底人、观兆的都进来，我将那梦告诉了他们，他们却不能把梦的讲解告诉我。
refs.text_big5: 於是那些術士、用法術的、迦勒底人、觀兆的都進來，我將那夢告訴了他們，他們卻不能把夢的講解告訴我。
refs.text_en: Then the magicians, conjurers, Chaldeans, and diviners came in, and I told the dream to them; but they could not make its interpretation known to me.

refs.text_gb: 王大声吩咐将用法术的、迦勒底人、并观兆的领进来；王对巴比伦的哲士说，什么人能读这文字，把讲解告诉我，他必身穿紫袍，项戴金链，在我国中掌权，位列第三。
refs.text_big5: 王大聲吩咐將用法術的、迦勒底人、並觀兆的領進來；王對巴比倫的哲士說，甚麼人能讀這文字，把講解告訴我，他必身穿紫袍，項戴金鍊，在我國中掌權，位列第三。
refs.text_en: The king cried loudly to bring the conjurers, the Chaldeans, and the diviners. The king responded and said to the wise men of Babylon, Any man who reads this writing and declares its interpretation to me shall be clothed in purple and shall have a chain of gold around his neck and shall rule as the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.text_gb: 王对他们说，我作了一个梦，灵里烦乱，要知道这梦是什么。
verses.text_big5: 王對他們說，我作了一個夢，靈裏煩亂，要知道這夢是甚麼。
verses.text_en: And the king said to them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王对他们说，我作了一个梦，灵里烦乱，要知道这梦是什么。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王對他們說，我作了一個夢，靈裏煩亂，要知道這夢是甚麼。

verses.text_gb: 迦勒底人用[Cra]亚兰语对王说，[Fn1]愿王万岁！请将那梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解说明。
verses.text_big5: 迦勒底人用[Cra]亞蘭語對王說，[Fn1]願王萬歲！請將那夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解說明。
verses.text_en: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic, O king, live forever! Tell the dream to your servants, and we will declare the interpretation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 迦勒底人用亚兰语对王说，愿王万岁！请将那梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解说明。
verses.text_big5_plain: 迦勒底人用亞蘭語對王說，願王萬歲！請將那夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解說明。

footnotes.zh: 从此处到七28的原文是亚兰文，不是希伯来文。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從此處到七28的原文是亞蘭文，不是希伯來文。

refs.text_gb: 亚达薛西在位的日子，比施兰、米特利达、他别、和他们的同僚写奏章给波斯王亚达薛西；奏章是用亚兰文字写的，译为亚兰方言。
refs.text_big5: 亞達薛西在位的日子，比施蘭、米特利達、他別、和他們的同僚寫奏章給波斯王亞達薛西；奏章是用亞蘭文字寫的，譯為亞蘭方言。
refs.text_en: And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes the king of Persia; and the script of the letter was written in Aramaic and translated into Aramaic.

refs.text_gb: 以利亚敬、舍伯那和约亚对军长说，求你用亚兰语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大语和我们说话，免得达到城墙上百姓的耳中。
refs.text_big5: 以利亞敬、舍伯那和約亞對軍長說，求你用亞蘭語和僕人說話，因為我們懂得；不要用猶大語和我們說話，免得達到城牆上百姓的耳中。
refs.text_en: And Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to the Rab-shakeh, Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, because we understand it; and do not speak to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people upon the wall.

verses.text_gb: 王回答迦勒底人说，我已发出命令，你们若不将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必被凌迟，你们的房屋必成为粪堆；
verses.text_big5: 王回答迦勒底人說，我已發出命令，你們若不將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必被凌遲，你們的房屋必成為糞堆；
verses.text_en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The command from me is published: If you do not make the dream and its interpretation known to me, you shall be cut into pieces and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王回答迦勒底人说，我已发出命令，你们若不将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必被凌迟，你们的房屋必成为粪堆；
verses.text_big5_plain: 王回答迦勒底人說，我已發出命令，你們若不將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必被凌遲，你們的房屋必成為糞堆；

verses.text_gb: 你们若将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必从我这里得赠品、赏赐、和大尊荣。现在你们要将梦和梦的讲解告诉我。
verses.text_big5: 你們若將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必從我這裏得贈品、賞賜、和大尊榮。現在你們要將夢和夢的講解告訴我。
verses.text_en: But if you declare the dream and its interpretation, you shall receive gifts and a reward and much honor from me. Therefore declare the dream and its interpretation to me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们若将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必从我这里得赠品、赏赐、和大尊荣。现在你们要将梦和梦的讲解告诉我。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們若將夢和夢的講解告訴我，就必從我這裏得贈品、賞賜、和大尊榮。現在你們要將夢和夢的講解告訴我。

verses.text_gb: 他们第二次回答王，说，请王将梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解说明。
verses.text_big5: 他們第二次回答王，說，請王將夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解說明。
verses.text_en: They answered a second time and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will declare the interpretation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们第二次回答王，说，请王将梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解说明。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們第二次回答王，說，請王將夢告訴僕人，僕人就可以講解說明。

verses.text_gb: 王回答说，我准知道你们是在拖延时间，因为你们看见我已发出命令；
verses.text_big5: 王回答說，我準知道你們是在拖延時間，因為你們看見我已發出命令；
verses.text_en: The king answered and said, I know for certain that you are trying to buy time because you have seen that the command from me is published.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王回答说，我准知道你们是在拖延时间，因为你们看见我已发出命令；
verses.text_big5_plain: 王回答說，我準知道你們是在拖延時間，因為你們看見我已發出命令；

verses.text_gb: 你们若不将梦告诉我，只有一条法令对待你们，因为你们在我面前协同说虚谎败坏的话，要等候时势改变。所以你们要将梦告诉我，我就知道你们能将梦的讲解告诉我。
verses.text_big5: 你們若不將夢告訴我，只有一條法令對待你們，因為你們在我面前協同說虛謊敗壞的話，要等候時勢改變。所以你們要將夢告訴我，我就知道你們能將夢的講解告訴我。
verses.text_en: But if you do not make the dream known to me, there is but one decree for you; for you have agreed together to speak false and corrupt words before me until the time is changed. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can declare its interpretation to me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们若不将梦告诉我，只有一条法令对待你们，因为你们在我面前协同说虚谎败坏的话，要等候时势改变。所以你们要将梦告诉我，我就知道你们能将梦的讲解告诉我。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們若不將夢告訴我，只有一條法令對待你們，因為你們在我面前協同說虛謊敗壞的話，要等候時勢改變。所以你們要將夢告訴我，我就知道你們能將夢的講解告訴我。

verses.text_gb: 迦勒底人在王面前回答说，地上没有人能将王所问的事说出来，因为没有大君王或掌权者，向术士、用法术的、或迦勒底人，问过这样的事。
verses.text_big5: 迦勒底人在王面前回答說，地上沒有人能將王所問的事說出來，因為沒有大君王或掌權者，向術士、用法術的、或迦勒底人，問過這樣的事。
verses.text_en: The Chaldeans answered before the king and said, There is not a man upon the earth who can declare the matter for the king, because no great king or ruler has ever asked any magician, conjurer, or Chaldean for something like this.
verses.text_gb_plain: 迦勒底人在王面前回答说，地上没有人能将王所问的事说出来，因为没有大君王或掌权者，向术士、用法术的、或迦勒底人，问过这样的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 迦勒底人在王面前回答說，地上沒有人能將王所問的事說出來，因為沒有大君王或掌權者，向術士、用法術的、或迦勒底人，問過這樣的事。

verses.text_gb: 王所问的事甚难，除了不与血肉之人同居的[Cra]神明，没有人能在王面前说出来。
verses.text_big5: 王所問的事甚難，除了不與血肉之人同居的[Cra]神明，沒有人能在王面前說出來。
verses.text_en: And the thing that the king asks is rare, and there is no one else who can declare it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王所问的事甚难，除了不与血肉之人同居的神明，没有人能在王面前说出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王所問的事甚難，除了不與血肉之人同居的神明，沒有人能在王面前說出來。

refs.text_gb: 只有一位在天上的神，能启示奥秘的事，祂已将末后日子必发生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦，就是你在床上脑中的异象，乃是这样。
refs.text_big5: 只有一位在天上的神，能啟示奧祕的事，祂已將末後日子必發生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢，就是你在床上腦中的異象，乃是這樣。
refs.text_en: But there is a God in the heavens who reveals mysteries, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the last days. This is your dream, even the visions of your head upon your bed.

refs.text_gb: 在你国中有一个人，他里头有圣神明的灵，你先祖在世的日子，见这人里头有光，又有聪明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他为术士、用法术的、迦勒底人、并观兆者的领袖；
refs.text_big5: 在你國中有一個人，他裏頭有聖神明的靈，你先祖在世的日子，見這人裏頭有光，又有聰明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他為術士、用法術的、迦勒底人、並觀兆者的領袖；
refs.text_en: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is a spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your forefather light and insight and wisdom like the wisdom of the gods were found in him. And King Nebuchadnezzar your forefather-your forefather, O king-made him chief of the magicians, conjurers, Chaldeans, and diviners,

verses.text_gb: 王为此生气，大发烈怒，吩咐灭绝巴比伦所有的哲士。
verses.text_big5: 王為此生氣，大發烈怒，吩咐滅絕巴比倫所有的哲士。
verses.text_en: Because of this the king was angry and very furious, and he gave orders to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王为此生气，大发烈怒，吩咐灭绝巴比伦所有的哲士。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王為此生氣，大發烈怒，吩咐滅絕巴比倫所有的哲士。

verses.text_gb: 于是命令发出，哲士将要被杀；人就寻找但以理和他的同伴，要杀他们。
verses.text_big5: 於是命令發出，哲士將要被殺；人就尋找但以理和他的同伴，要殺他們。
verses.text_en: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his companions so that they might be slain.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是命令发出，哲士将要被杀；人就寻找但以理和他的同伴，要杀他们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是命令發出，哲士將要被殺；人就尋找但以理和他的同伴，要殺他們。

verses.text_gb: 王的护卫长亚略出来，要杀巴比伦的哲士，但以理就用机智、审慎的话回答他，
verses.text_big5: 王的護衛長亞略出來，要殺巴比倫的哲士，但以理就用機智、審慎的話回答他，
verses.text_en: Then Daniel responded in counsel and with discretion to Arioch, the captain of the king's bodyguard, who had gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王的护卫长亚略出来，要杀巴比伦的哲士，但以理就用机智、审慎的话回答他，
verses.text_big5_plain: 王的護衛長亞略出來，要殺巴比倫的哲士，但以理就用機智、審慎的話回答他，

verses.text_gb: 向王的军长亚略说，从王发出的命令为何这样严厉呢？亚略就将情节告诉但以理。
verses.text_big5: 向王的軍長亞略說，從王發出的命令為何這樣嚴厲呢？亞略就將情節告訴但以理。
verses.text_en: He answered and said to Arioch, the king's commander, Why is the decree from before the king so harsh? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 向王的军长亚略说，从王发出的命令为何这样严厉呢？亚略就将情节告诉但以理。
verses.text_big5_plain: 向王的軍長亞略說，從王發出的命令為何這樣嚴厲呢？亞略就將情節告訴但以理。

verses.text_gb: 但以理遂进去求王宽限，就可以将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.text_big5: 但以理遂進去求王寬限，就可以將夢的講解告訴王。
verses.text_en: Daniel then went in and sought from the king that he would give him a time to declare the interpretation to the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但以理遂进去求王宽限，就可以将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但以理遂進去求王寬限，就可以將夢的講解告訴王。

footnotes.zh: 尼布甲尼撒的奇梦应当给他深刻的印象，但因着他被属世的荣华和权势所蒙蔽，无心为着神的权益，以致无法明白这梦，至终也忘了这梦(1～3)。巴比伦的一切术士、哲士，以及迦勒底人，都无法将梦告诉他(4～13)。然而，有一个名叫但以理的人，不在意属世的荣华和权势，反而将他的心放置于神在地上权益之属灵的事上；他有对的地位和对的角度，他里面也有内在的性能，能以明白这梦。他没有作这梦，却从神领受了关于这梦的异象(17～23)，并讲解这梦(24～25)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 尼布甲尼撒的奇夢應當給他深刻的印象，但因著他被屬世的榮華和權勢所蒙蔽，無心為著神的權益，以致無法明白這夢，至終也忘了這夢。（1～3。）巴比倫的一切術士、哲士，以及迦勒底人，都無法將夢告訴他。（4～13。）然而，有一個名叫但以理的人，不在意屬世的榮華和權勢，反而將他的心放置於神在地上權益之屬靈的事上；他有對的地位和對的角度，他裏面也有內在的性能，能以明白這夢。他沒有作這夢，卻從神領受了關於這夢的異象，（17～23，）並講解這夢。（24～25。）
footnotes.en: 2:17 1 Daniel Nebuchadnezzar's marvelous dream should have impressed him deeply, but because he was blinded by worldly glory and power and did not have a heart for God's interests, he could not understand the dream and eventually forgot it (vv. 1-3). All the magicians, all the wise men of Babylon, and the Chaldeans were unable to tell him the dream (vv. 4-13). However, there was a person named Daniel, who did not care for worldly glory and power, who set his heart on the spiritual things regarding God's interests on earth, and who had the right position, the right angle, and the intrinsic capacity within him to understand the dream. He did not have the dream, yet he received the vision from God concerning it (vv. 17-23), and he interpreted it (vv. 24-45).

refs.text_gb: 太监长给他们起名，称但以理为伯提沙撒，称哈拿尼雅为沙得拉，称米沙利为米煞，称亚撒利雅为亚伯尼歌。

refs.text_big5: 因為在你那裏，有生命的源頭；在你的光中，我們必得見光。
refs.text_en: For with You is the fountain of life; / In Your light we see light.

refs.text_gb: 在你国中有一个人，他里头有圣神明的灵，你先祖在世的日子，见这人里头有光，又有聪明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他为术士、用法术的、迦勒底人、并观兆者的领袖；
refs.text_big5: 在你國中有一個人，他裏頭有聖神明的靈，你先祖在世的日子，見這人裏頭有光，又有聰明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他為術士、用法術的、迦勒底人、並觀兆者的領袖；
refs.text_en: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is a spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your forefather light and insight and wisdom like the wisdom of the gods were found in him. And King Nebuchadnezzar your forefather-your forefather, O king-made him chief of the magicians, conjurers, Chaldeans, and diviners,

refs.text_gb: 我听说你里头有神明的灵，并且有光，又有聪明和超越的智慧。
refs.text_big5: 我聽說你裏頭有神明的靈，並且有光，又有聰明和超越的智慧。
refs.text_en: Now I have heard about you that a spirit of the gods is in you and that light and insight and surpassing wisdom are found in you.

verses.text_gb: 我列祖的神啊，我感谢你，赞美你，因你将智慧、能力赐给了我；如今你已使我知道我们向你所求的，把王的事指示我们。
verses.text_big5: 我列祖的神阿，我感謝你，讚美你，因你將智慧、能力賜給了我；如今你已使我知道我們向你所求的，把王的事指示我們。
verses.text_en: To You, O God of my fathers, I render thanks and praise, / For You have given me wisdom and might; / And You have now made known to me what we requested of You, / For You have made known the king's matter to us.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我列祖的神啊，我感谢你，赞美你，因你将智慧、能力赐给了我；如今你已使我知道我们向你所求的，把王的事指示我们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我列祖的神阿，我感謝你，讚美你，因你將智慧、能力賜給了我；如今你已使我知道我們向你所求的，把王的事指示我們。

verses.text_gb: 于是但以理进去见亚略，就是王所派灭绝巴比伦哲士的，对他说，不要灭绝巴比伦的哲士，求你领我到王面前，我要将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.text_big5: 於是但以理進去見亞略，就是王所派滅絕巴比倫哲士的，對他說，不要滅絕巴比倫的哲士，求你領我到王面前，我要將夢的講解告訴王。
verses.text_en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon; he went and said thus to him, Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon; bring me before the king, and I will declare the interpretation to the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是但以理进去见亚略，就是王所派灭绝巴比伦哲士的，对他说，不要灭绝巴比伦的哲士，求你领我到王面前，我要将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是但以理進去見亞略，就是王所派滅絕巴比倫哲士的，對他說，不要滅絕巴比倫的哲士，求你領我到王面前，我要將夢的講解告訴王。

verses.text_gb: 亚略就急忙将但以理领到王面前，对王说，我在被掳的犹大人中遇见一人，他要将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.text_big5: 亞略就急忙將但以理領到王面前，對王說，我在被擄的猶大人中遇見一人，他要將夢的講解告訴王。
verses.text_en: Then Arioch brought Daniel hurriedly before the king and spoke in this way to him, I have found a man among the captives of Judah who will make the interpretation known to the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚略就急忙将但以理领到王面前，对王说，我在被掳的犹大人中遇见一人，他要将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞略就急忙將但以理領到王面前，對王說，我在被擄的猶大人中遇見一人，他要將夢的講解告訴王。

verses.text_gb: 王对称为伯提沙撒的但以理说，你能将我所作的梦和梦的讲解，告诉我么？
verses.text_big5: 王對稱為伯提沙撒的但以理說，你能將我所作的夢和夢的講解，告訴我麼？
verses.text_en: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Are you able to make known to me the dream that I have seen and its interpretation?
verses.text_gb_plain: 王对称为伯提沙撒的但以理说，你能将我所作的梦和梦的讲解，告诉我么？
verses.text_big5_plain: 王對稱為伯提沙撒的但以理說，你能將我所作的夢和夢的講解，告訴我麼？

verses.text_gb: 但以理在王面前回答说，王所问的那奥秘事，哲士、用法术的、术士、观兆的，都不能告诉王；
verses.text_big5: 但以理在王面前回答說，王所問的那奧祕事，哲士、用法術的、術士、觀兆的，都不能告訴王；
verses.text_en: Daniel answered before the king and said, As to the mystery which the king has inquired about, no wise men, no conjurers, magicians, or diviners, are able to declare it to the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但以理在王面前回答说，王所问的那奥秘事，哲士、用法术的、术士、观兆的，都不能告诉王；
verses.text_big5_plain: 但以理在王面前回答說，王所問的那奧祕事，哲士、用法術的、術士、觀兆的，都不能告訴王；

verses.text_gb: 只有一位在天上的[Fn1][Cra]神，能启示奥秘的事，祂已将末后日子必发生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦，就是你在床上脑中的异象，乃是这样。
verses.text_big5: 只有一位在天上的[Fn1][Cra]神，能啟示奧祕的事，祂已將末後日子必發生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢，就是你在床上腦中的異象，乃是這樣。
verses.text_en: But there is a God in the heavens who reveals mysteries, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the last days. This is your dream, even the visions of your head upon your bed.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只有一位在天上的神，能启示奥秘的事，祂已将末后日子必发生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦，就是你在床上脑中的异象，乃是这样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只有一位在天上的神，能啟示奧祕的事，祂已將末後日子必發生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢，就是你在床上腦中的異象，乃是這樣。

footnotes.zh: 在讲解尼布甲尼撒的梦时，但以理高举神(25～30)，没有高举自己。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在講解尼布甲尼撒的夢時，但以理高舉神，（25～30，）沒有高舉自己。
footnotes.en: 2:28 1 God In his interpreting of Nebuchadnezzar's dream, Daniel exalted God (vv. 25-30). He did not exalt himself.

refs.text_gb: 要他们为这奥秘的事，在天上的神面前求怜恤，免得但以理和他的同伴，与巴比伦其余的哲士一同灭亡。
refs.text_big5: 要他們為這奧祕的事，在天上的神面前求憐恤，免得但以理和他的同伴，與巴比倫其餘的哲士一同滅亡。
refs.text_en: That they might request compassions from before the God of the heavens concerning this mystery so that Daniel and his companions would not be destroyed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 王对但以理说，你既能将这奥秘的事启示出来，你们的神诚然是万神之神，万王之主，又是奥秘事的启示者。
refs.text_big5: 王對但以理說，你既能將這奧祕的事啟示出來，你們的神誠然是萬神之神，萬王之主，又是奧祕事的啟示者。
refs.text_en: The king answered Daniel and said, It is certain that your God is the God of gods and the Lord of kings and a Revealer of mysteries, for you have been able to reveal this mystery.

refs.text_gb: 他们对他说，我们各人作了一个梦，没有人能解。约瑟说，解梦不是神的事么？请你们将梦告诉我。
refs.text_big5: 他們對他說，我們各人作了一個夢，沒有人能解。約瑟說，解夢不是神的事麼？請你們將夢告訴我。
refs.text_en: And they said to him, We have had a dream, and there is no one to interpret it. And Joseph said to them, Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.

refs.text_gb: 约瑟回答法老说，这不在于我，神必将平安的话回答法老。
refs.text_big5: 約瑟回答法老說，這不在於我，神必將平安的話回答法老。
refs.text_en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not of me; God will give Pharaoh a favorable answer.

refs.text_gb: 那造山，创风，将祂的意念指示人，使晨光变为幽暗，脚踏在地之高处的，耶和华万军之神是祂的名！
refs.text_big5: 那造山，創風，將祂的意念指示人，使晨光變為幽暗，腳踏在地之高處的，耶和華萬軍之神是祂的名！
refs.text_en: For it is He who forms the mountains and creates the wind / And declares to man what His thought is; / He who makes the morning darkness / And treads upon the high places of the earth - / Jehovah the God of hosts is His name!

verses.text_gb: 王啊，你在床上想到后来要发生的事，那启示奥秘事的主，就把将来必发生的事指示你。
verses.text_big5: 王阿，你在床上想到後來要發生的事，那啟示奧祕事的主，就把將來必發生的事指示你。
verses.text_en: As for you, O king, your thoughts on your bed came upon what would happen after these times, and He who reveals mysteries has made known to you what will happen.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王啊，你在床上想到后来要发生的事，那启示奥秘事的主，就把将来必发生的事指示你。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王阿，你在床上想到後來要發生的事，那啟示奧祕事的主，就把將來必發生的事指示你。

verses.text_gb: 至于我，这奥秘的事启示给我，并非因我的智慧胜过一切活人，乃为使王知道梦的讲解，并使王知道心里的思念。
verses.text_big5: 至於我，這奧祕的事啟示給我，並非因我的智慧勝過一切活人，乃為使王知道夢的講解，並使王知道心裏的思念。
verses.text_en: But as for me, this mystery has not been revealed to me because of some wisdom that is in me more than in any other living person, but so that the interpretation may be made known to the king and that you may understand the thoughts of your heart.
verses.text_gb_plain: 至于我，这奥秘的事启示给我，并非因我的智慧胜过一切活人，乃为使王知道梦的讲解，并使王知道心里的思念。
verses.text_big5_plain: 至於我，這奧祕的事啟示給我，並非因我的智慧勝過一切活人，乃為使王知道夢的講解，並使王知道心裏的思念。

verses.text_gb: 王啊，你观看，看见一个大[Fn1][Cra]像。这像巨大，极其光耀，站在你面前，样子甚是可怕。
verses.text_big5: 王阿，你觀看，看見一個大[Fn1][Cra]像。這像巨大，極其光耀，站在你面前，樣子甚是可怕。
verses.text_en: You, O king, were watching, and there was a single great image. This image, large and its brightness surpassing, stood opposite you; and its appearance was frightful.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王啊，你观看，看见一个大像。这像巨大，极其光耀，站在你面前，样子甚是可怕。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王阿，你觀看，看見一個大像。這像巨大，極其光耀，站在你面前，樣子甚是可怕。

footnotes.zh: 尼布甲尼撒之梦的内容，乃是大人像及其定命。本章里大人像的异象，乃是但以理书支配的异象。这大人像表征全人类历史中人类政权的集大成，从人类政权开始于示拿地的巴别(巴比伦)(创十8～10，十一1～9)，即人像的头所表征的，到人类历史中人类政权终结于罗马帝国同其十王(见32注1二段)，即十个脚指头所表征的(40～44上，七24，启十三1，十七12)。人类政权从始至终，一直在作三件事：背叛神、高举人以及拜偶像(创十一4与注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 尼布甲尼撒之夢的內容，乃是大人像及其定命。本章裏大人像的異象，乃是但以理書支配的異象。這大人像表徵全人類歷史中人類政權的集大成，從人類政權開始於示拿地的巴別（巴比倫，）（創十8～10，十一1～9，）即人像的頭所表徵的，到人類歷史中人類政權終結於羅馬帝國同其十王，（見32註1二段，）即十個腳指頭所表徵的。（40～44上，七24，啟十三1，十七12。）人類政權從始至終，一直在作三件事：背叛神、高舉人、以及拜偶像。（創十一4與註2。）
footnotes.en: 2:31 1 image The contents of Nebuchadnezzar's dream were a great human image and its destiny. The vision of the great image in this chapter is the controlling vision in the book of Daniel. This great image signifies the aggregate of human government throughout human history, from the beginning of human government at Babel (Babylon) in the land of Shinar (Gen. 10:8-10; 11:1-9), as signified by the head of the image, to the termination of human government in human history in the Roman Empire with the ten kings (see note Dan. 2:32 1 , par. 2), as signified by the ten toes (vv. 40-44a; Dan. 7:24; Rev. 13:1; 17:12). From its beginning to its termination, human government has always done three things: rebel against God, exalt man, and worship idols (Gen. 11:4 and note Gen. 11:4 2 ).

refs.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒王造了一个金像，高六十肘，宽六肘，立在巴比伦省的杜拉平原。
refs.text_big5: 尼布甲尼撒王造了一個金像，高六十肘，寬六肘，立在巴比倫省的杜拉平原。
refs.text_en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, its height sixty cubits and its width six cubits; he set it up in the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

verses.text_gb: 这像的[Fn1]头是精[Cra]金的，胸膛和膀臂是银的，肚腹和腰是[Crb]铜的，
verses.text_big5: 這像的[Fn1]頭是精[Cra]金的，胸膛和膀臂是銀的，肚腹和腰是[Crb]銅的，
verses.text_en: Concerning this image, its head was of fine gold, its breast and its arms of silver, its abdomen and its thighs of bronze,
verses.text_gb_plain: 这像的头是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是银的，肚腹和腰是铜的，
verses.text_big5_plain: 這像的頭是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是銀的，肚腹和腰是銅的，

footnotes.zh: 金头(36～38)相当于七3～4的头一个兽，表征尼布甲尼撒，即巴比伦的创建者和王。银的胸膛和膀臂(39上)，相当于七5的第二个兽，表征玛代波斯。铜的肚腹和腰(39下)，相当于七6的第三个兽，表征希腊，包括马其顿。铁的腿和半铁半泥的脚(33)，相当于七7～8的第四个兽，表征罗马帝国连同其末了的十王(40～44上，七7～11，19～26，启十七7～13)。 按照本章的人像，在神看来，整个历史中人类的一切政权，乃是由巴比伦、玛代波斯、马其顿希腊和罗马这四个帝国组成的。人类政权开始于宁录所建造的巴别(巴比伦)(创十8～10)，结束于敌基督统治下复兴的罗马帝国。虽然罗马帝国的形态和外表已经消失，但罗马帝国的文化、精神和素质今天仍继续存在(见七12注1)。在大灾难开始时(太二四21)，罗马帝国的形态和外表将在敌基督手下得着恢复。按照但以理书和启示录，罗马帝国最后一位该撒将是十王所拥护的敌基督(启十七10～12与注)。因此，宁录在巴别所开始的人类帝国，其集大成要完成于敌基督同他的十王。 大人像的头若是巴比伦，整个人像也应该是巴比伦。在神眼中，从宁录到敌基督的整个人类政权乃是巴比伦。在最后一位该撒敌基督的统治下，罗马帝国将是政治和宗教的巴比伦(启十七～十八)。敌基督的帝国将是政治和物质的巴比伦，也就是‘大巴比伦；’(启十八2)；而称为‘奥秘哉！大巴比伦’(启十七5)的罗马天主教，将是宗教的巴比伦。见耶五十1注1一段。
footnotes.en: 2:32 1 head The head of gold (vv. 36-38), corresponding to the first beast in Dan. 7:3-4, signifies Nebuchadnezzar, the founder and the king of Babylon. The breast and the arms of silver (v. 39a), corresponding to the second beast in Dan. 7:5, signify Medo-Persia, and the abdomen and thighs of bronze (v. 39b), corresponding to the third beast in Dan. 7:6, signify Greece, including Macedonia. The legs of iron and the feet partly of iron and partly of clay (v. 33), corresponding to the fourth beast in Dan. 7:7-8, signify the Roman Empire with its last ten kings (vv. 40-44a; Dan. 7:7-11, 19-26; Rev. 17:7-13). According to the human image in this chapter, in the sight of God all human government throughout history is composed of four empires: the Babylonian Empire, the Medo-Persian Empire, the Macedonian-Grecian Empire, and the Roman Empire. The beginning of human government was at Babel (Babylon), which was built by Nimrod (Gen. 10:8-10), and the ending of human government will be the revived Roman Empire under Antichrist. Although the form and appearance of the Roman Empire have vanished, the culture, spirit, and essence of the Roman Empire continue to exist today (see note Dan. 7:12 1 ). At the beginning of the great tribulation (Matt. 24:21) the form and appearance of the Roman Empire will be restored under Antichrist. According to the books of Daniel and Revelation, the last Caesar of the Roman Empire will be Antichrist, who will be supported by ten kings (Rev. 17:10-12 and notes). Thus, the aggregate of human empires that began with Nimrod at Babel will consummate with Antichrist and his ten kings. If the head of the great human image is Babylon, the entire image must also be Babylon. In the eyes of God, the entire human government from Nimrod to Antichrist is Babylon. Under Antichrist, the last Caesar, the Roman Empire will be both political and religious Babylon (Rev. 17—18). The empire of Antichrist will be the political and physical Babylon, i.e., “Babylon the Great” (Rev. 18:2), whereas the Roman Catholic Church, called “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT” (Rev. 17:5), will be the religious Babylon. See note Jer. 50:1 1 , par. 1.

refs.text_gb: 你必提这诗歌论巴比伦王说，欺压人的何竟息灭！狂暴的何竟止息！
refs.text_big5: 你必題這詩歌論巴比倫王說，欺壓人的何竟息滅！狂暴的何竟止息！
refs.text_en: You will lift up this discourse concerning the king of Babylon and you will say: How the oppressor has ceased! / How the raging has ceased!

refs.text_gb: 巴比伦素来是耶和华手中的金杯，使全地沉醉；列国喝了她的酒就癫狂了。
refs.text_big5: 巴比倫素來是耶和華手中的金杯，使全地沉醉；列國喝了她的酒就癲狂了。
refs.text_en: Babylon has been a golden cup in Jehovah's hand / That has made all the earth drunk. / The nations have drunk of her wine; / Therefore the nations have become mad.

refs.text_gb: 无论住在何处的世人、田野的走兽、并天空的飞鸟，祂都已交付你手，使你掌管这一切。你就是那金头。
refs.text_big5: 無論住在何處的世人、田野的走獸、並天空的飛鳥，祂都已交付你手，使你掌管這一切。你就是那金頭。
refs.text_en: And wherever the children of men, the beasts of the field, or the birds of the sky dwell, He has given them into your hand and has made you ruler over all of them. You are the head of gold.

refs.text_gb: 在你以后必另有一国兴起，不及于你；又有第三国，就是铜的，必掌管全地。
refs.text_big5: 在你以後必另有一國興起，不及於你；又有第三國，就是銅的，必掌管全地。
refs.text_en: And after you another kingdom will arise, inferior to you; and there will be another kingdom, a third one, of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

footnotes.zh: 两条铁腿表征东罗马帝国和西罗马帝国，而半铁半泥的脚与脚指头(41～43)，表征在罗马亡国之后，到基督再来之前，这段期间的国家。这些国家有些是专制的，有些是民主的。人像的十个脚指头，表征敌基督统治下得了复兴并恢复之罗马帝国的十王(44上，七7，24，启十七12)。大人像的前三部分和两腿所表征的历史时期，已经应验，但十个脚指头所表征的时期，尚未应验。这时期要应验于现今世代的末了。见32注1二段。
footnotes.zh_big5: 兩條鐵腿表徵東羅馬帝國和西羅馬帝國，而半鐵半泥的腳與腳指頭，（41～43，）表徵在羅馬亡國之後，到基督再來之前，這段期間的國家。這些國家有些是專制的，有些是民主的。人像的十個腳指頭，表徵敵基督統治下得了復興並恢復之羅馬帝國的十王。（44上，七7，24，啟十七12。）大人像的前三部分和兩腿所表徵的歷史時期，已經應驗，但十個腳指頭所表徵的時期，尚未應驗。這時期要應驗於現今世代的末了。見32註1二段。
footnotes.en: 2:33 1 legs The two legs of iron signify the eastern Roman Empire and the western Roman Empire, and the feet and the toes, partly of iron and partly of clay (vv. 41-43), signify the nations in the period after the fall of Rome and before Christ's second coming. These nations are partly autocratic and partly democratic. The ten toes of the image signify the ten kings of the revived and restored Roman Empire under Antichrist (v. 44a; Dan. 7:7, 24; Rev. 17:12). The periods of history signified by the first three parts of the great human image and the two legs have been fulfilled, but the period signified by the ten toes has not yet been fulfilled. It will be fulfilled at the end of the present age. See note Dan. 2:32 1 , par. 2.

refs.text_gb: 必有第四国，坚强如铁，像铁一样能打碎克制百物；铁怎样能压碎一切，那国也必照样打碎压制列国。

refs.text_en: And there will be a fourth kingdom as strong as iron, inasmuch as iron crushes and shatters everything; and like iron that smashes all these, it will crush and smash.

refs.text_gb: 你既看见那像的脚和脚指头，一半是窑匠的泥，一半是铁，那国将来也必是混杂的；你既看见铁与陶泥搀杂，那国也必有铁的坚硬；
refs.text_big5: 你既看見那像的腳和腳指頭，一半是窯匠的泥，一半是鐵，那國將來也必是混雜的；你既看見鐵與陶泥攙雜，那國也必有鐵的堅硬；
refs.text_en: And in that you saw the feet and the toes, partly of potter's clay and partly of iron, the kingdom will be a confused mass; but there will be some of the firmness of iron in it, for you saw the iron mixed with the earthy clay.

refs.text_gb: 那些脚指头，既是半铁半泥，那国也必半强半弱；
refs.text_big5: 那些腳指頭，既是半鐵半泥，那國也必半強半弱；
refs.text_en: And as the toes of the feet were partly of iron and partly of clay, so some of the kingdom will be strong and part of it will be fragile.

refs.text_gb: 你既看见铁与陶泥搀杂，那国的民也必人种搀杂，却不能彼此相合，正如铁与泥不能搀合一样。
refs.text_big5: 你既看見鐵與陶泥攙雜，那國的民也必人種攙雜，卻不能彼此相合，正如鐵與泥不能攙合一樣。
refs.text_en: And in that you saw the iron mixed with the earthy clay, they will be mixed together through the seed of men, but they will not cleave to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

verses.text_gb: 你观看，见有一块非人手凿出来的[Fn1][Cra]石头，[Fn2]打在这像半铁半泥的脚上，把脚[Crb]砸碎。
verses.text_big5: 你觀看，見有一塊非人手鑿出來的[Fn1][Cra]石頭，[Fn2]打在這像半鐵半泥的腳上，把腳[Crb]砸碎。
verses.text_en: You were watching until a stone was cut out without hands, and it struck the image at its feet of iron and clay and crushed them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你观看，见有一块非人手凿出来的石头，打在这像半铁半泥的脚上，把脚砸碎。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你觀看，見有一塊非人手鑿出來的石頭，打在這像半鐵半泥的腳上，把腳砸碎。

footnotes.zh: 大人像的定命乃是被一块非人手凿出来的石头砸碎(34～35上，44下～45)。这石头就是基督。基督借着钉十字架被治死，而为神所凿(亚三9，徒二23)；并且祂在复活里(徒二24)，被凿成一块具有三方面讲究的石头：为着建造召会，乃是基石和房角石(赛二八16，太二一42)；对不信的犹太人，乃是绊脚的石头(赛八14，太二一44上，罗九33)；以及为着毁灭人类政权的总和，乃是砸人的石头(太二一44下)。 当基督这砸人的石头来临时，祂不是单独的来，乃是同着祂的得胜者(祂的新妇，祂的扩增)作为祂的军队而来(约三29～30，启十七14，十九7～8，11，14)。在召会时代，就是奥秘时代，基督正在建造召会作祂的新妇(弗五25～29)。基督降临地上以前，将有一次婚礼，祂要迎娶得胜者(启十九7～9)，就是那些多年与神的仇敌争战，且已经胜过那恶者的人(参启十二11)。婚礼之后，祂这作丈夫的要与祂新娶的新妇同来，毁灭敌基督；这敌基督同他的军队将要直接与神争战(启十七14，十九19)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 大人像的定命乃是被一塊非人手鑿出來的石頭砸碎。（34～35上，44下～45。）這石頭就是基督。基督藉著釘十字架被治死，而為神所鑿；（亞三9，徒二23；）並且祂在復活裏，（徒二24，）被鑿成一塊具有三方面講究的石頭：為著建造召會，乃是基石和房角石；（賽二八16，太二一42；）對不信的猶太人，乃是絆腳的石頭；（賽八14，太二一44上，羅九33；）以及為著毀滅人類政權的總和，乃是砸人的石頭。（太二一44下。）ˍ當基督這砸人的石頭來臨時，祂不是單獨的來，乃是同著祂的得勝者（祂的新婦，祂的擴增）作為祂的軍隊而來。（約三29～30，啟十七14，十九7～8，11，14。）在召會時代，就是奧祕時代，基督正在建造召會作祂的新婦。（弗五25～29。）基督降臨地上以前，將有一次婚禮，祂要迎娶得勝者，（啟十九7～9，）就是那些多年與神的仇敵爭戰，且已經勝過那惡者的人。（參啟十二11。）婚禮之後，祂這作丈夫的要與祂新娶的新婦同來，毀滅敵基督；這敵基督同他的軍隊將要直接與神爭戰。（啟十七14，十九19。）
footnotes.en: 2:34 1 stone The destiny of the great human image is to be crushed by a stone cut out without hands (vv. 34-35, 44-45). This stone is Christ. Through His crucifixion Christ was cut by God by being put to death (Zech. 3:9; Acts 2:23), and in His resurrection (Acts 2:24) He was cut out to be a stone in three aspects: the foundation stone and the cornerstone for the building up of the church (Isa. 28:16; Matt. 21:42), the stumbling stone to the unbelieving Jews (Isa. 8:14; Matt. 21:44a; Rom. 9:33), and the crushing stone to destroy the totality of human government (Matt. 21:44b). When Christ comes as the crushing stone, He will not come alone; rather, He will come with His overcomers, His bride, His increase, as His army (John 3:29-30; Rev. 17:14; 19:7-8, 11, 14). During the church age, the age of mystery, Christ is building up the church to be His bride (Eph. 5:25-29). Before He descends to earth, Christ will have a wedding, in which He will marry the overcomers (Rev. 19:7-9), those who have been fighting the battle against God's enemy for years and who have already overcome the evil one (cf. Rev. 12:11). After His wedding, He as the Husband will come with His newlywed bride to destroy Antichrist, who with his army will fight against God directly (Rev. 17:14; 19:19).

footnotes.zh: 当基督作为神所凿的石头显现时，祂同祂的得胜者—团体的基督—要击打十王和敌基督(启十九11～21)，把大人像从脚趾到头砸得粉碎(35)。这将是基督对那从敌基督回溯到宁录之人类政权的集大成，包罗一切的审判，因而结束地上旧造里人类政权的时代，并引进神在千年国，以及永世新天新地里掌管全地的时代。
footnotes.en: 2:34 2 struck; crushed At His appearing as the God-cut stone, Christ with His overcomers — the corporate Christ — will strike the ten kings with Antichrist (Rev. 19:11-21), thereby crushing the great image from the toes to the head (v. 35). This will be Christ's universal judgment on the aggregate of human government from Antichrist back to Nimrod, thus ending the age of man's government on earth in the old creation and initiating the age of God's dominion over the entire earth in the millennium and in the new heaven and new earth for eternity.

footnotes.zh: 这里的大山表征神永远的国，要永远充满全地(44，七13～14)。团体的基督—基督同祂得胜的新妇—来砸碎人类政权的集大成以后，要变成一座大山，充满全地，使全地成为神的国。因此，大人像要被地上神永远的国所顶替(启十一15～17)。 石头扩增成为大山，表征基督的扩增(参约三29～30)。召会是基督在生命上的扩增，而神永远的国乃是基督在行政上的扩增(可四26～29)。因此，基督不仅是召会，也是神的国(林前十二12，路十七21)。基督作为石头，乃是神行动的中心；祂作为山，乃是普及。因此，基督是包罗万有者，就是那在万有中充满万有者(弗一23)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的大山表徵神永遠的國，要永遠充滿全地。（44，七13～14。）團體的基督—基督同祂得勝的新婦—來砸碎人類政權的集大成以後，要變成一座大山，充滿全地，使全地成為神的國。因此，大人像要被地上神永遠的國所頂替。（啟十一15～17。）ˍ石頭擴增成為大山，表徵基督的擴增。（參約三29～30。）召會是基督在生命上的擴增，而神永遠的國乃是基督在行政上的擴增。（可四26～29。）因此，基督不僅是召會，也是神的國。（林前十二12，路十七21。）基督作為石頭，乃是神行動的中心；祂作為山，乃是普及。因此，基督是包羅萬有者，就是那在萬有中充滿萬有者。（弗一23。）

verses.text_big5: 這就是那夢；我們在王面前要講解那夢。
verses.text_en: This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这就是那梦；我们在王面前要讲解那梦。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這就是那夢；我們在王面前要講解那夢。

verses.text_gb: 王啊，你是[Cra]诸王之王，[Crb]天上的神已将国度、权能、力量、荣耀，都赐给了你；
verses.text_big5: 王阿，你是[Cra]諸王之王，[Crb]天上的神已將國度、權能、力量、榮耀，都賜給了你；
verses.text_en: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of the heavens has given kingship, power, and strength and glory.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王啊，你是诸王之王，天上的神已将国度、权能、力量、荣耀，都赐给了你；
verses.text_big5_plain: 王阿，你是諸王之王，天上的神已將國度、權能、力量、榮耀，都賜給了你；

refs.text_gb: 因为主耶和华如此说，我必使诸王之王，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，率领马匹、战车、马兵、和聚集的许多人民，从北方来攻击你推罗。
refs.text_big5: 因為主耶和華如此說，我必使諸王之王，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒，率領馬匹、戰車、馬兵、和聚集的許多人民，從北方來攻擊你推羅。
refs.text_en: For thus says the Lord Jehovah, I am about to bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, the king of kings, with horses, chariots, horsemen, a company, and many people.

refs.text_gb: 诸王之王亚达薛西，达于祭司以斯拉，精通天上神律法的经学家，愿诸事美满。如今
refs.text_big5: 諸王之王亞達薛西，達於祭司以斯拉，精通天上神律法的經學家，願諸事美滿。如今
refs.text_en: Artaxerxes, the king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace. And now

refs.text_gb: 波斯王古列如此说，耶和华天上的神已将地上万国赐给我，又嘱咐我在犹大的耶路撒冷为祂建造殿宇。
refs.text_big5: 波斯王古列如此說，耶和華天上的神已將地上萬國賜給我，又囑咐我在猶大的耶路撒冷為祂建造殿宇。
refs.text_en: Thus says Cyrus the king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth has Jehovah the God of heaven given to me; and He has charged me to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

verses.text_gb: 无论住在何处的[Fn1]世人、田野的[Cra]走兽、并天空的飞鸟，祂都已交付你手，使你掌管这一切。你就是那[Crb]金头。
verses.text_big5: 無論住在何處的[Fn1]世人、田野的[Cra]走獸、並天空的飛鳥，祂都已交付你手，使你掌管這一切。你就是那[Crb]金頭。
verses.text_en: And wherever the children of men, the beasts of the field, or the birds of the sky dwell, He has given them into your hand and has made you ruler over all of them. You are the head of gold.
verses.text_gb_plain: 无论住在何处的世人、田野的走兽、并天空的飞鸟，祂都已交付你手，使你掌管这一切。你就是那金头。
verses.text_big5_plain: 無論住在何處的世人、田野的走獸、並天空的飛鳥，祂都已交付你手，使你掌管這一切。你就是那金頭。

footnotes.zh: 直译，人的子孙。五21者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，人的子孫。五21者同。

refs.text_gb: 树的叶子华美，果子甚多，可作众生的食物，野地的走兽住在其下，天空的飞鸟宿在枝上；
refs.text_big5: 樹的葉子華美，果子甚多，可作眾生的食物，野地的走獸住在其下，天空的飛鳥宿在枝上；
refs.text_en: And whose foliage was beautiful and its fruit abundant, and in which was food for all, and under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and in whose branches the birds of the sky lodged -

refs.text_gb: 王啊，这长大又坚固的树就是你，因为你的威势渐长及天，你的权柄达到地极。
refs.text_big5: 王阿，這長大又堅固的樹就是你，因為你的威勢漸長及天，你的權柄達到地極。
refs.text_en: It is you, O king, who have grown great and become strong, for your greatness has grown and reaches to heaven, and your dominion to the end of the earth.

refs.text_gb: 现在我将这些地，都交在我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，我也将田野的走兽给了他，好为他服役。
refs.text_big5: 現在我將這些地，都交在我僕人巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的手中，我也將田野的走獸給了他，好為他服役。
refs.text_en: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant; and I have also given him the beasts of the field to serve him.

refs.text_gb: 这像的头是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是银的，肚腹和腰是铜的，
refs.text_big5: 這像的頭是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是銀的，肚腹和腰是銅的，
refs.text_en: Concerning this image, its head was of fine gold, its breast and its arms of silver, its abdomen and its thighs of bronze,

verses.text_gb: 在你以后必[Cra]另有一国兴起，不及于你；又有[Crb]第三国，就是铜的，必掌管全地。
verses.text_big5: 在你以後必[Cra]另有一國興起，不及於你；又有[Crb]第三國，就是銅的，必掌管全地。
verses.text_en: And after you another kingdom will arise, inferior to you; and there will be another kingdom, a third one, of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在你以后必另有一国兴起，不及于你；又有第三国，就是铜的，必掌管全地。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在你以後必另有一國興起，不及於你；又有第三國，就是銅的，必掌管全地。

refs.text_gb: 毗勒斯，就是你的国分裂，归与玛代人和波斯人。
refs.text_big5: 毘勒斯，就是你的國分裂，歸與瑪代人和波斯人。
refs.text_en: PERES-Your kingdom has been divided and given to the Medes and Persians.

refs.text_gb: 玛代人大利乌，约六十二岁，取了迦勒底国。
refs.text_big5: 瑪代人大利烏，約六十二歲，取了迦勒底國。
refs.text_en: And Darius the Mede received the kingdom at about the age of sixty-two.

refs.text_gb: 此后我观看，又有一兽如豹，背上有鸟的四个翅膀；这兽有四个头，又有权柄给了它。
refs.text_big5: 此後我觀看，又有一獸如豹，背上有鳥的四個翅膀；這獸有四個頭，又有權柄給了牠。
refs.text_en: After this I watched and there was another beast, like a leopard; and it had four wings of a bird on its back; and the beast had four heads, and dominion was given to it.

refs.text_gb: 我正思想的时候，见有一只公山羊从西而来，遍行全地，脚不触地；这山羊两眼之间，有一显著的角。
refs.text_big5: 我正思想的時候，見有一隻公山羊從西而來，遍行全地，腳不觸地；這山羊兩眼之間，有一顯著的角。
refs.text_en: And while I considered this, there was a male goat, coming from the west over the face of the whole earth without touching the ground; and the goat had a conspicuous horn between his eyes.

refs.text_gb: 必有一个有能力的王兴起，执掌大权，随意而行。
refs.text_big5: 必有一個有能力的王興起，執掌大權，隨意而行。
refs.text_en: And a mighty king will arise there, and he will rule with great dominion and do as he pleases.

verses.text_gb: 必有[Cra]第四国，坚强如铁，像铁一样能打碎克制百物；铁怎样能压碎一切，那国也必照样打碎压制列国。
verses.text_big5: 必有[Cra]第四國，堅強如鐵，像鐵一樣能打碎剋制百物；鐵怎樣能壓碎一切，那國也必照樣打碎壓制列國。
verses.text_en: And there will be a fourth kingdom as strong as iron, inasmuch as iron crushes and shatters everything; and like iron that smashes all these, it will crush and smash.
verses.text_gb_plain: 必有第四国，坚强如铁，像铁一样能打碎克制百物；铁怎样能压碎一切，那国也必照样打碎压制列国。
verses.text_big5_plain: 必有第四國，堅強如鐵，像鐵一樣能打碎剋制百物；鐵怎樣能壓碎一切，那國也必照樣打碎壓制列國。

refs.text_gb: 其后我在夜间的异象中观看，见第四兽甚是可怕可惧，极其强壮；这兽有大铁牙，吞吃嚼碎，所余剩的用脚践踏；这兽与前三兽不同，头有十角；
refs.text_big5: 其後我在夜間的異象中觀看，見第四獸甚是可怕可懼，極其強壯；這獸有大鐵牙，吞喫嚼碎，所餘剩的用腳踐踏；這獸與前三獸不同，頭有十角；
refs.text_en: After this I watched in the night visions, and there was a fourth beast, dreadful and frightful and exceedingly strong; and it had large iron teeth; it devoured and crushed and trampled down the remainder with its feet; and it was different from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

refs.text_gb: 那侍立者这样说，第四兽就是地上必有的第四国，与一切国不同，必吞吃全地，并且践踏嚼碎。
refs.text_big5: 那侍立者這樣說，第四獸就是地上必有的第四國，與一切國不同，必吞喫全地，並且踐踏嚼碎。
refs.text_en: Thus he said, The fourth beast will be the fourth kingdom upon the earth, which will be different from all the other kingdoms; and it will devour the whole earth and tread it down and crush it.

verses.text_gb: 你既看见那像的[Cra]脚和脚指头，一半是窑匠的泥，一半是铁，那国将来也必是[Fn1]混杂的；你既看见铁与[Fn2]陶泥搀杂，那国也必有铁的[Fn3]坚硬；
verses.text_big5: 你既看見那像的[Cra]腳和腳指頭，一半是窯匠的泥，一半是鐵，那國將來也必是[Fn1]混雜的；你既看見鐵與[Fn2]陶泥攙雜，那國也必有鐵的[Fn3]堅硬；
verses.text_en: And in that you saw the feet and the toes, partly of potter's clay and partly of iron, the kingdom will be a confused mass; but there will be some of the firmness of iron in it, for you saw the iron mixed with the earthy clay.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你既看见那像的脚和脚指头，一半是窑匠的泥，一半是铁，那国将来也必是混杂的；你既看见铁与陶泥搀杂，那国也必有铁的坚硬；
verses.text_big5_plain: 你既看見那像的腳和腳指頭，一半是窯匠的泥，一半是鐵，那國將來也必是混雜的；你既看見鐵與陶泥攙雜，那國也必有鐵的堅硬；

footnotes.zh: 直译，分裂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，分裂。
footnotes.en: 2:41 1 confused Lit., divided.

footnotes.zh: 强调泥所意味的，与铁所意味的成对比。
footnotes.zh_big5: 強調泥所意味的，與鐵所意味的成對比。
footnotes.en: 2:41 2 firmness Denoting standing strength.

footnotes.zh: 指站立的力量。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指站立的力量。
footnotes.en: 2:41 3 earthy Emphasizing the notion of clay in contrast to the notion of iron.

refs.text_gb: 腿是铁的，脚是半铁半泥的。
refs.text_big5: 腿是鐵的，腳是半鐵半泥的。
refs.text_en: Its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.

verses.text_gb: 那些脚指头，既是半铁半泥，那国也必半强半弱；
verses.text_big5: 那些腳指頭，既是半鐵半泥，那國也必半強半弱；
verses.text_en: And as the toes of the feet were partly of iron and partly of clay, so some of the kingdom will be strong and part of it will be fragile.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那些脚指头，既是半铁半泥，那国也必半强半弱；
verses.text_big5_plain: 那些腳指頭，既是半鐵半泥，那國也必半強半弱；

verses.text_gb: 你既看见铁与陶泥搀杂，那国的民也必人种搀杂，却不能彼此相合，正如铁与泥不能搀合一样。
verses.text_big5: 你既看見鐵與陶泥攙雜，那國的民也必人種攙雜，卻不能彼此相合，正如鐵與泥不能攙合一樣。
verses.text_en: And in that you saw the iron mixed with the earthy clay, they will be mixed together through the seed of men, but they will not cleave to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你既看见铁与陶泥搀杂，那国的民也必人种搀杂，却不能彼此相合，正如铁与泥不能搀合一样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你既看見鐵與陶泥攙雜，那國的民也必人種攙雜，卻不能彼此相合，正如鐵與泥不能攙合一樣。

verses.text_gb: 当那列王在位的日子，[Cra]天上的神必兴起一[Crb]国，[Crc]永不败灭，国权也不留归别民，却要打碎灭绝那一切国；这国必存到永远。
verses.text_big5: 當那列王在位的日子，[Cra]天上的神必興起一[Crb]國，[Crc]永不敗滅，國權也不留歸別民，卻要打碎滅絕那一切國；這國必存到永遠。
verses.text_en: And in the days of those kings the God of the heavens will raise up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, and its reign will not be left to another people; it will crush and put an end to all these kingdoms; and it will stand forever.
verses.text_gb_plain: 当那列王在位的日子，天上的神必兴起一国，永不败灭，国权也不留归别民，却要打碎灭绝那一切国；这国必存到永远。
verses.text_big5_plain: 當那列王在位的日子，天上的神必興起一國，永不敗滅，國權也不留歸別民，卻要打碎滅絕那一切國；這國必存到永遠。

refs.text_gb: 只有一位在天上的神，能启示奥秘的事，祂已将末后日子必发生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦，就是你在床上脑中的异象，乃是这样。
refs.text_big5: 只有一位在天上的神，能啟示奧祕的事，祂已將末後日子必發生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢，就是你在床上腦中的異象，乃是這樣。
refs.text_en: But there is a God in the heavens who reveals mysteries, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the last days. This is your dream, even the visions of your head upon your bed.

refs.text_gb: 正在那时候，地大震动，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的人有七千名，其余的都惊恐，将荣耀归与天上的神。
refs.text_big5: 正在那時候，地大震動，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的人有七千名，其餘的都驚恐，將榮耀歸與天上的神。
refs.text_en: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell; and seven thousand men were killed in the earthquake, and the rest became terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

refs.text_gb: 你们要悔改，因为诸天的国已经临近了。
refs.text_big5: 你們要悔改，因為諸天的國已經臨近了。
refs.text_en: And saying, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.

refs.text_gb: 愿你的国来临，愿你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
refs.text_big5: 願你的國來臨，願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。
refs.text_en: Your kingdom come; Your will be done, as in heaven, so also on earth.

refs.text_gb: 人子要差遣祂的使者，从祂的国里薅集一切绊跌人的事，和行不法的人，
refs.text_big5: 人子要差遣祂的使者，從祂的國裏薅集一切絆跌人的事，和行不法的人，
refs.text_en: The Son of Man will send His angels, and they will collect out of His kingdom all the stumbling blocks and those who practice lawlessness,

refs.text_gb: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说，世上的国，成了我主和祂基督的国，祂要作王，直到永永远远。
refs.text_big5: 第七位天使吹號，天上就有大聲音說，世上的國，成了我主和祂基督的國，祂要作王，直到永永遠遠。
refs.text_en: And the seventh angel trumpeted; and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.

refs.text_gb: 祂的神迹何其伟大，祂的奇事何其有能！祂的国是永远的国，祂的权柄存到万代。
refs.text_big5: 祂的神蹟何其偉大，祂的奇事何其有能！祂的國是永遠的國，祂的權柄存到萬代。
refs.text_en: How great are His signs, / And how mighty are His wonders! / His kingdom is an eternal kingdom, / And His dominion is from generation to generation.

refs.text_gb: 那些日子过后，我尼布甲尼撒举目望天，我的理性复归于我，我便颂赞至高者，赞美尊敬那永活者；因为祂的权柄是永远的权柄，祂的国存到万代。
refs.text_big5: 那些日子過後，我尼布甲尼撒舉目望天，我的理性復歸於我，我便頌讚至高者，讚美尊敬那永活者；因為祂的權柄是永遠的權柄，祂的國存到萬代。
refs.text_en: And at the end of those days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and reason returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored the ever-living One; For His dominion is an eternal dominion, / And His kingdom is from generation to generation;

refs.text_gb: 现在我下令，在我所统辖的国内，人都要在但以理的神面前战兢恐惧；因为祂是活神，永远长存；祂的国永不败坏，祂的权柄永存无终。
refs.text_big5: 現在我下令，在我所統轄的國內，人都要在但以理的神面前戰兢恐懼；因為祂是活神，永遠長存；祂的國永不敗壞，祂的權柄永存無終。
refs.text_en: I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel; For He is the living God / And enduring forever; / And His kingdom is one which will not be destroyed, / And His dominion will be unto the end.

refs.text_gb: 权柄、荣耀、国度都给了祂，使各族、各国、各方言的人都事奉祂。祂的权柄是永远的权柄，不能废去，祂的国必不毁坏。
refs.text_big5: 權柄、榮耀、國度都給了祂，使各族、各國、各方言的人都事奉祂。祂的權柄是永遠的權柄，不能廢去，祂的國必不毀壞。
refs.text_en: And to Him was given dominion, glory, and a kingdom, / That all the peoples, nations, and languages might serve Him. / His dominion is an eternal dominion, which will not pass away; / And His kingdom is one that will not be destroyed.

refs.text_gb: 我必使瘸腿的成为余剩之民，使那被赶到远方的成为强盛之国；耶和华要在锡安山作王治理他们，从今直到永远。
refs.text_big5: 我必使瘸腿的成為餘剩之民，使那被趕到遠方的成為強盛之國；耶和華要在錫安山作王治理他們，從今直到永遠。
refs.text_en: And I will make her that limps a remnant, / And her that has been cast far away a mighty nation; / And Jehovah will reign over them in Mount Zion / From then on, and even forever.

refs.text_gb: 祂要为大，称为至高者的儿子，主神要把祂祖大卫的宝座给祂，
refs.text_big5: 祂要為大，稱為至高者的兒子，主神要把祂祖大衛的寶座給祂，
refs.text_en: He will be great and will be called Son of the Most High; and the Lord God will give to Him the throne of David His father,

refs.text_gb: 祂要作雅各家的王，直到永远，祂的国也没有穷尽。

refs.text_en: And He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and of His kingdom there will be no end.

verses.text_gb: 你既看见非人手凿出来的一块[Cra]石头，从山而出，打碎铁、铜、泥、银、金，那就是至大的神把后来必发生的事给王指明。这梦准是这样，这讲解也是可信的。
verses.text_big5: 你既看見非人手鑿出來的一塊[Cra]石頭，從山而出，打碎鐵、銅、泥、銀、金，那就是至大的神把後來必發生的事給王指明。這夢準是這樣，這講解也是可信的。
verses.text_en: Inasmuch as you saw that out of the mountain a stone was cut without hands and that it crushed the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen afterward; and the dream is certain, and its interpretation trustworthy.

refs.text_en: You were watching until a stone was cut out without hands, and it struck the image at its feet of iron and clay and crushed them.

refs.text_gb: 所以主耶和华如此说：看哪，我在锡安放一块石头，作为根基，是试验过的石头，是宝贵的房角石，作为稳固的根基；信靠的人必不着急。
refs.text_big5: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我在錫安放一塊石頭，作為根基，是試驗過的石頭，是寶貴的房角石，作為穩固的根基；信靠的人必不著急。
refs.text_en: Therefore thus says / The Lord Jehovah: / Indeed I lay a stone in Zion as a foundation, / A tested stone, / A precious cornerstone as a foundation firmly established; / He who believes will not hasten away.

verses.text_gb: 王对但以理说，你既能将这奥秘的事启示出来，你们的神诚然是万神之神，万王之主，又是奥秘事的[Cra]启示者。
verses.text_big5: 王對但以理說，你既能將這奧祕的事啟示出來，你們的神誠然是萬神之神，萬王之主，又是奧祕事的[Cra]啟示者。
verses.text_en: The king answered Daniel and said, It is certain that your God is the God of gods and the Lord of kings and a Revealer of mysteries, for you have been able to reveal this mystery.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王对但以理说，你既能将这奥秘的事启示出来，你们的神诚然是万神之神，万王之主，又是奥秘事的启示者。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王對但以理說，你既能將這奧祕的事啟示出來，你們的神誠然是萬神之神，萬王之主，又是奧祕事的啟示者。

refs.text_gb: 只有一位在天上的神，能启示奥秘的事，祂已将末后日子必发生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦，就是你在床上脑中的异象，乃是这样。
refs.text_big5: 只有一位在天上的神，能啟示奧祕的事，祂已將末後日子必發生的事，指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的夢，就是你在床上腦中的異象，乃是這樣。
refs.text_en: But there is a God in the heavens who reveals mysteries, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the last days. This is your dream, even the visions of your head upon your bed.

refs.text_gb: 至于我，这奥秘的事启示给我，并非因我的智慧胜过一切活人，乃为使王知道梦的讲解，并使王知道心里的思念。
refs.text_big5: 至於我，這奧祕的事啟示給我，並非因我的智慧勝過一切活人，乃為使王知道夢的講解，並使王知道心裏的思念。
refs.text_en: But as for me, this mystery has not been revealed to me because of some wisdom that is in me more than in any other living person, but so that the interpretation may be made known to the king and that you may understand the thoughts of your heart.

verses.text_gb: 于是王使但以理尊大，赏赐他许多贵重礼物，派他[Cra]管理巴比伦全省，又立他为[Crb]总长，掌管巴比伦的一切哲士。

verses.text_en: Then the king made Daniel great and gave many great gifts to him; and he made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon and chief of the prefects over all the wise men of Babylon.

refs.text_en: Then Belshazzar commanded; and they clothed Daniel in purple and put a chain of gold around his neck, and they made the proclamation concerning him that he should rule as the third ruler in the kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 又在他们以上立总长三人，（但以理为其中之一，）使这些总督向他们三人呈报，免得王受亏损。
refs.text_big5: 又在他們以上立總長三人，（但以理為其中之一，）使這些總督向他們三人呈報，免得王受虧損。
refs.text_en: And over them, three chief ministers-of whom Daniel was one-so that these satraps might give account to them and the king might not suffer loss.

refs.text_gb: 术士的领袖伯提沙撒啊，因我知道你里头有圣神明的灵，没有什么奥秘的事能使你为难；这是我梦中所见的异象，你要把讲解告诉我。
refs.text_big5: 術士的領袖伯提沙撒阿，因我知道你裏頭有聖神明的靈，沒有甚麼奧祕的事能使你為難；這是我夢中所見的異象，你要把講解告訴我。
refs.text_en: O Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, because I know that a spirit of the holy gods is in you and no mystery troubles you, here are the visions of my dream that I have seen; now tell me its interpretation.

refs.text_gb: 在你国中有一个人，他里头有圣神明的灵，你先祖在世的日子，见这人里头有光，又有聪明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他为术士、用法术的、迦勒底人、并观兆者的领袖；
refs.text_big5: 在你國中有一個人，他裏頭有聖神明的靈，你先祖在世的日子，見這人裏頭有光，又有聰明智慧，好像神明的智慧；你先祖尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的先祖，立他為術士、用法術的、迦勒底人、並觀兆者的領袖；
refs.text_en: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is a spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your forefather light and insight and wisdom like the wisdom of the gods were found in him. And King Nebuchadnezzar your forefather-your forefather, O king-made him chief of the magicians, conjurers, Chaldeans, and diviners,

refs.text_gb: 王啊，你观看，看见一个大像。这像巨大，极其光耀，站在你面前，样子甚是可怕。

refs.text_en: You, O king, were watching, and there was a single great image. This image, large and its brightness surpassing, stood opposite you; and its appearance was frightful.

verses.text_gb_plain: 于是总督、司令、省长、审判长、财政官员、司法官员、审判官、和各省的官员，都聚集了来，要为尼布甲尼撒王所立的像，行开光之礼，就站在尼布甲尼撒所立的像前。

refs.text_en: He also shall drink of the wine of the fury of God, which is mixed undiluted in the cup of His wrath; and he shall be tormented in fire and brimstone before the holy angels and before the Lamb.

refs.text_en: And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

verses.text_gb: 因此各族、各国、各方言的人，一听见角、笛、七弦琴、三角琴、瑟、[Fn1]风笛、和各样乐器的声音，就都俯伏敬拜尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像。

verses.text_en: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, lyre, trigon, psaltery, bagpipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, nations, and languages fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

refs.text_big5: 他們便進到王前，題王的禁令，說，王阿，三十日內不拘何人，若在王以外向任何神明或任何人求甚麼，必扔在獅子坑中，王不是簽署了這條禁令麼？王回答說，實有這事，照瑪代人和波斯人的法例，是不可廢除的。
refs.text_en: Then they came near and spoke before the king concerning the king's edict: Did you not sign an edict that anyone who petitions, within the next thirty days, any god or man besides you, O king, shall be cast into the lions' den? The king answered and said, The thing is certain, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot pass away.

refs.text_en: Declare among the nations and proclaim; / Lift up a banner, proclaim it. / Do not conceal it, but say, / Babylon is captured; / Bel is put to shame; / Merodach is shattered; / Her images are put to shame; / Her idols are dismayed.

refs.text_en: And power was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast that the image of the beast might even speak and cause whoever would not worship the image of the beast to be killed.

verses.text_big5: 沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌這三個人，都被捆著落在烈火的窯中。
verses.text_en: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell into the midst of the blazing furnace of fire bound up.
verses.text_gb_plain: 沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌这三个人，都被捆着落在烈火的窑中。
verses.text_big5_plain: 沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌這三個人，都被捆著落在烈火的窯中。

verses.text_gb: 那时尼布甲尼撒王惊奇，急忙起来，对谋士说，我们岂不是把三个人捆起来扔在火里么？他们回答王说，王啊，确实是的。
verses.text_big5: 那時尼布甲尼撒王驚奇，急忙起來，對謀士說，我們豈不是把三個人捆起來扔在火裏麼？他們回答王說，王阿，確實是的。
verses.text_en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and stood up in haste; he responded and said to his counselors, Did we not throw three men into the midst of the fire bound up? They answered and said to the king, Certainly, O king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时尼布甲尼撒王惊奇，急忙起来，对谋士说，我们岂不是把三个人捆起来扔在火里么？他们回答王说，王啊，确实是的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時尼布甲尼撒王驚奇，急忙起來，對謀士說，我們豈不是把三個人捆起來扔在火裏麼？他們回答王說，王阿，確實是的。

verses.text_gb: 王说，看哪，我见有四个人，并没有捆绑，在火中[Cra]行走，也没有受伤；那[Fn1]第四个的相貌，好像[Crb]神子。
verses.text_big5: 王說，看哪，我見有四個人，並沒有捆綁，在火中[Cra]行走，也沒有受傷；那[Fn1]第四個的相貌，好像[Crb]神子。
verses.text_en: He answered and said, Look, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire; and they are not harmed. And the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王说，看哪，我见有四个人，并没有捆绑，在火中行走，也没有受伤；那第四个的相貌，好像神子。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王說，看哪，我見有四個人，並沒有捆綁，在火中行走，也沒有受傷；那第四個的相貌，好像神子。

footnotes.zh: 这第四个乃是超越的基督作为人子，来与祂三个受苦、遭逼迫的得胜者同在，并使这火成为令人愉悦、可以在其中行走的地方。这三位得胜者，不需要求神拯救他们脱离火窑(参17)。人子基督这位够资格并且能在凡事上同情神子民者(来四15)，来作他们的同伴，在他们受苦时照顾他们；借着祂的同在，祂使他们受苦的地方成为愉快的处境。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這第四個乃是超越的基督作為人子，來與祂三個受苦、遭逼迫的得勝者同在，並使這火成為令人愉悅、可以在其中行走的地方。這三位得勝者，不需要求神拯救他們脫離火窯。（參17。）人子基督這位彀資格、並且能在凡事上同情神子民者，（來四15，）來作他們的同伴，在他們受苦時照顧他們；藉著祂的同在，祂使他們受苦的地方成為愉快的處境。
footnotes.en: 3:25 1 fourth This fourth one was the excellent Christ as the Son of Man, who had come to be with His three suffering, persecuted overcomers and to make the fire a pleasant place in which to walk about. The three overcomers did not need to ask God to deliver them from the furnace (cf. v. 17). Christ as the Son of Man — the One who is qualified and capable of sympathizing with God's people in everything (Heb. 4:15) — came to be their Companion and take care of them in their suffering, by His presence making their place of suffering a pleasant situation.

refs.text_gb: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在；你蹚过江河，水必不漫过你。你从火中行过，必不被烧，火焰必不烧着你。
refs.text_big5: 你從水中經過，我必與你同在；你蹚過江河，水必不漫過你。你從火中行過，必不被燒，火焰必不燒著你。
refs.text_en: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, / And through the rivers, they will not flow over you. / And when you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, / And the flame will not consume you.

refs.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒说，沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神是当受颂赞的，祂差遣使者救护祂的仆人，他们信靠祂，不遵王言，宁舍己身，在他们神以外不肯事奉敬拜别神；
refs.text_big5: 尼布甲尼撒說，沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌的神是當受頌讚的，祂差遣使者救護祂的僕人，他們信靠祂，不遵王言，寧捨己身，在他們神以外不肯事奉敬拜別神；
refs.text_en: Nebuchadnezzar responded and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who has sent His angel and delivered His servants who trusted in Him and changed the king's word and yielded their bodies that they might not serve nor worship any god except their own God.

refs.text_gb: 有一天，神的众子来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来在其中。
refs.text_big5: 有一天，神的眾子來侍立在耶和華面前，撒但也來在其中。
refs.text_en: Then one day, when the sons of God came to present themselves before Jehovah, Satan also came among them.

refs.text_gb: 那时晨星一同歌唱，神的众子也都欢呼。
refs.text_big5: 那時晨星一同歌唱，神的眾子也都歡呼。
refs.text_en: When the morning stars sang together / And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的使者，在敬畏祂的人四围安营，搭救他们。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者，在敬畏祂的人四圍安營，搭救他們。
refs.text_en: The angel of Jehovah encamps / Around those who fear Him, and He delivers them.

verses.text_gb: 于是尼布甲尼撒就近烈火窑门，说，[Cra]至高神的[Crb]仆人沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌出来，到这里来吧。沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌就从火中出来了。
verses.text_big5: 於是尼布甲尼撒就近烈火窯門，說，[Cra]至高神的[Crb]僕人沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌出來，到這裏來罷。沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌就從火中出來了。
verses.text_en: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the door of the blazing furnace of fire. He responded and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, servants of God the Most High, come out and come here. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego came out of the midst of the fire.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是尼布甲尼撒就近烈火窑门，说，至高神的仆人沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌出来，到这里来吧。沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌就从火中出来了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是尼布甲尼撒就近烈火窯門，說，至高神的僕人沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌出來，到這裏來罷。沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌就從火中出來了。

refs.text_gb: 又有撒冷王麦基洗德带着饼和酒出来迎接；他是至高神的祭司。
refs.text_big5: 又有撒冷王麥基洗德帶著餅和酒出來迎接；他是至高神的祭司。
refs.text_en: And Melchizedek the king of Salem brought out bread and wine. Now he was priest of God the Most High.

refs.text_gb: 得听神的言语，得知至高者的知识，得见全足者的异象，仆倒而眼目得开的人宣告说，
refs.text_big5: 得聽神的言語，得知至高者的知識，得見全足者的異象，仆倒而眼目得開的人宣告說，
refs.text_en: He declares, he who hears the words of God / And obtains the knowledge of the Most High, / Who sees the vision of the All-sufficient One, / Falling down, but having his eyes uncovered:

refs.text_gb: 我要呼求至高的神，就是为我成全诸事的神。
refs.text_big5: 我要呼求至高的神，就是為我成全諸事的神。
refs.text_en: I call out to God the Most High, / To the God who accomplishes all things for me.

refs.text_gb: 大声喊叫说，至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你何干？我指着神切求你，不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_big5: 大聲喊叫說，至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你何干？我指著神切求你，不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_en: And crying out with a loud voice, he said, What do I have to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I adjure You by God, do not torment me!

refs.text_gb: 他看见耶稣，就喊叫起来，俯伏在祂面前，大声说，至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你何干？求你不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_big5: 他看見耶穌，就喊叫起來，俯伏在祂面前，大聲說，至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你何干？求你不要叫我受苦。
refs.text_en: And when he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell before Him and said in a loud voice, What do I have to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beseech You, do not torment me.

refs.text_gb: 他临近坑边，哀声呼叫但以理，对但以理说，活神的仆人但以理啊，你所常事奉的神能救你脱离狮子么？
refs.text_big5: 他臨近坑邊，哀聲呼叫但以理，對但以理說，活神的僕人但以理阿，你所常事奉的神能救你脫離獅子麼？
refs.text_en: And when he had come near the den, he shouted to Daniel with a sad voice; the king responded and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to deliver you from the lions?

refs.text_gb: 她跟随保罗和我们，喊着说，这些人是至高神的奴仆，向你们宣传救人的道路。
refs.text_big5: 她跟隨保羅和我們，喊著說，這些人是至高神的奴僕，向你們宣傳救人的道路。
refs.text_en: This woman followed after Paul and us and cried out, saying, These men are slaves of the Most High God, who announce to you a way of salvation.

verses.text_gb: 那些总督、司令、省长、和王的谋士，一同聚集看这三个人，见火[Cra]无力伤及他们的身体，他们的头发没有烧焦，衣裳没有变色，身上也没有火燎的气味。
verses.text_big5: 那些總督、司令、省長、和王的謀士，一同聚集看這三個人，見火[Cra]無力傷及他們的身體，他們的頭髮沒有燒焦，衣裳沒有變色，身上也沒有火燎的氣味。
verses.text_en: And the satraps, prefects, and governors, and the king's counselors, being gathered together, saw concerning these men that the fire had no effect on their bodies and that the hair of their heads was not singed, nor had their clothes been affected, nor had the smell of fire come upon them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那些总督、司令、省长、和王的谋士，一同聚集看这三个人，见火无力伤及他们的身体，他们的头发没有烧焦，衣裳没有变色，身上也没有火燎的气味。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那些總督、司令、省長、和王的謀士，一同聚集看這三個人，見火無力傷及他們的身體，他們的頭髮沒有燒焦，衣裳沒有變色，身上也沒有火燎的氣味。

refs.text_gb: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在；你蹚过江河，水必不漫过你。你从火中行过，必不被烧，火焰必不烧着你。
refs.text_big5: 你從水中經過，我必與你同在；你蹚過江河，水必不漫過你。你從火中行過，必不被燒，火焰必不燒著你。
refs.text_en: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, / And through the rivers, they will not flow over you. / And when you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, / And the flame will not consume you.

refs.text_gb: 灭了烈火的猛势，脱了刀剑的锋刃，软弱得着加力，争战显出大能，打退外邦的军队。
refs.text_big5: 滅了烈火的猛勢，脫了刀劍的鋒刃，軟弱得著加力，爭戰顯出大能，打退外邦的軍隊。
refs.text_en: Quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, were made strong in weakness, became mighty in war, routed the armies of foreigners.

verses.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒说，沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神是当受颂赞的，祂差遣[Cra]使者救护祂的仆人，他们信靠祂，[Fn1]不遵王言，宁舍己[Crb]身，在他们神以外不肯事奉敬拜别神；

verses.text_gb_plain: 尼布甲尼撒说，沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神是当受颂赞的，祂差遣使者救护祂的仆人，他们信靠祂，不遵王言，宁舍己身，在他们神以外不肯事奉敬拜别神；

footnotes.zh: 直译，改变王言。这三位年轻的得胜者，不是仅仅使王言受挫，他们乃是改变了王言的性质，无惧于舍身丧命。因此，他们胜过了拜偶像的引诱。因着他们的得胜，神能向撒但夸耀说，即使在他的领域中，神仍有一班敬拜祂的子民。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，改變王言。這三位年輕的得勝者，不是僅僅使王言受挫，他們乃是改變了王言的性質，無懼於捨身喪命。因此，他們勝過了拜偶像的引誘。因著他們的得勝，神能向撒但誇耀說，即使在他的領域中，神仍有一班敬拜祂的子民。
footnotes.en: 3:28 1 changed The three young overcomers did not simply frustrate the king's word — they changed it in nature and were not afraid to yield their bodies to be killed. Thus, they gained the victory over the seduction of idol worship. Because of their victory God could boast to Satan that even in his territory He had a people who worshipped Him.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的使者，在敬畏祂的人四围安营，搭救他们。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者，在敬畏祂的人四圍安營，搭救他們。
refs.text_en: The angel of Jehovah encamps / Around those who fear Him, and He delivers them.

refs.text_gb: 我的神差遣使者，封住狮子的口，叫狮子不伤我，因我在神面前显为无辜，我在王面前也没有行过害人的事。
refs.text_big5: 我的神差遣使者，封住獅子的口，叫獅子不傷我，因我在神面前顯為無辜，我在王面前也沒有行過害人的事。
refs.text_en: My God has sent His angel and has shut the lions' mouth, and they have not hurt me, inasmuch as before Him innocence was found in me; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.

refs.text_gb: 王就甚为喜乐，吩咐人将但以理从坑里系上来；于是但以理从坑里被系上来；身上不见任何伤损，因为他信靠他的神。
refs.text_big5: 王就甚為喜樂，吩咐人將但以理從坑裏繫上來；於是但以理從坑裏被繫上來；身上不見任何傷損，因為他信靠他的神。
refs.text_en: Then the king was very pleased concerning him, and he commanded that they take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and he was found completely unhurt, because he had trusted in his God.

refs.text_gb: 彼得清醒过来，说，我现在真知道主差遣祂的使者，救我脱离希律的手，和犹太百姓一切所期待的。
refs.text_big5: 彼得清醒過來，說，我現在真知道主差遣祂的使者，救我脫離希律的手，和猶太百姓一切所期待的。
refs.text_en: And Peter came to himself and said, Now I know truly that the Lord has sent forth His angel and rescued me out of Herod's hand and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.

refs.text_gb: 我若将我一切所有的变卖为食物分给人吃，又舍己身叫我可以夸口，却没有爱，仍然与我无益。
refs.text_big5: 我若將我一切所有的變賣為食物分給人喫，又捨己身叫我可以誇口，卻沒有愛，仍然與我無益。
refs.text_en: And if I dole out all my possessions to feed others, and if I deliver up my body that I may boast, but do not have love, I profit nothing.

verses.text_gb: 现在我降旨，无论何族、何国、何方言的人，谤讟沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌之神的，必被凌迟，他的房屋必成粪堆，因为没有别神能这样施行拯救。
verses.text_big5: 現在我降旨，無論何族、何國、何方言的人，謗讟沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌之神的，必被凌遲，他的房屋必成糞堆，因為沒有別神能這樣施行拯救。
verses.text_en: Therefore I make a decree that any people, nation, or language that speaks something offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego shall be cut into pieces and their houses shall be made a dunghill, because there is no other god who is able to deliver in this way.
verses.text_gb_plain: 现在我降旨，无论何族、何国、何方言的人，谤讟沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌之神的，必被凌迟，他的房屋必成粪堆，因为没有别神能这样施行拯救。
verses.text_big5_plain: 現在我降旨，無論何族、何國、何方言的人，謗讟沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌之神的，必被凌遲，他的房屋必成糞堆，因為沒有別神能這樣施行拯救。

verses.text_gb: 那时王使沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌在巴比伦省得亨通。
verses.text_big5: 那時王使沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌在巴比倫省得亨通。
verses.text_en: Then the king caused Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego to prosper in the province of Babylon.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时王使沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌在巴比伦省得亨通。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時王使沙得拉、米煞、亞伯尼歌在巴比倫省得亨通。

verses.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒王晓谕住在全地各族、各国、各方言的人，说，愿你们[Cra]大享平安。
verses.text_big5: 尼布甲尼撒王曉諭住在全地各族、各國、各方言的人，說，願你們[Cra]大享平安。
verses.text_en: Nebuchadnezzar the king to all the peoples, nations, and languages that dwell in the whole earth: May your peace abound!
verses.text_gb_plain: 尼布甲尼撒王晓谕住在全地各族、各国、各方言的人，说，愿你们大享平安。
verses.text_big5_plain: 尼布甲尼撒王曉諭住在全地各族、各國、各方言的人，說，願你們大享平安。

refs.text_gb: 那时大利乌王致书给住在全地，各族、各国、各方言的人，说，愿你们大享平安！
refs.text_big5: 那時大利烏王致書給住在全地，各族、各國、各方言的人，說，願你們大享平安！
refs.text_en: Then Darius the king wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages that dwell in the whole land: May your peace abound!

verses.text_gb: 我乐意将至高的神向我所行的神迹奇事，宣扬出来。
verses.text_big5: 我樂意將至高的神向我所行的神蹟奇事，宣揚出來。
verses.text_en: It pleases me to declare the signs and wonders that God the Most High has done for me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我乐意将至高的神向我所行的神迹奇事，宣扬出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我樂意將至高的神向我所行的神蹟奇事，宣揚出來。

verses.text_gb: 祂的神迹何其伟大，祂的奇事何其有能！祂的国是[Cra]永远的国，祂的权柄存到万代。
verses.text_big5: 祂的神蹟何其偉大，祂的奇事何其有能！祂的國是[Cra]永遠的國，祂的權柄存到萬代。
verses.text_en: How great are His signs, / And how mighty are His wonders! / His kingdom is an eternal kingdom, / And His dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂的神迹何其伟大，祂的奇事何其有能！祂的国是永远的国，祂的权柄存到万代。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂的神蹟何其偉大，祂的奇事何其有能！祂的國是永遠的國，祂的權柄存到萬代。
